titleEn: An Integrated Approach for Improving the Sustainable Use of Nikopol-Turnu Magurele Cross-border Cultural Heritage
summaryEn:
Nikopol-Turnu Magurele region is characterized by remarkable natural and cultural heritage and landscape features. Nevertheless, poor accessibility to sites of cultural-historical importance, lack of attractions and integrated tourist products, services and promotion strategies lead to mismanaged tourism flows and usage conflicts.

The project aims to improve the sustainable use of Nikopol-Turnu Magurele cross-border cultural heritage by developing, implementing and promoting an integrated joint approach for investing in sustainable tourism. The budget of the operation is 5 881 227.63 €<.

The project envisages investments in tourist infrastructure, integrated tourism products and services, effective marketing, awareness raising and promotion interventions realized with the active involvement of local inhabitants and stakeholders, thus creating viable economic uses of cross-border cultural heritage and increasing the tourist visits and overnights.

These objectives will be accomplished through construction works for restoring Turnu Magurele fortress, constructing Nikopol archeological park with access road to Cliff Church, 3 stakeholder workshops for developing 9 integrated tourist products/services, 1 joint marketing strategy, 1 joint information web portal and smartphone application, 8 info terminals, 2 clubs for historical restorations, 1 large-scale cross-border festival, online publicity and awareness raising campaign, information and publicity materials.

titleEn: Development and promotion of an integrated cultural heritage tourism product: Route “Roman frontier within the cross-border region Romania-Bulgaria”
summaryEn:
The CBC region has great requisites for cultural tourism under the theme “Roman heritage”: large number of well-preserved Roman sites and objects, archeological research, investments in infrastructure, museums with valuable Roman collections. The local communities find a great sense of identity and pride in their Roman heritage. Work is underway to include a number of Roman sites in the cross-border region in UNESCO indicative list of world heritage. To fully develop and enhance this potential, it is necessary to take an integrated cross-border, strategic and cohesive approach, drawing on the best expertise and on the input of all stakeholders, integrating local ownership and sustainability.

The Project’s objective is enhancement of the sustainable use of common cultural heritage within the CBC area through the development of an integrated culture heritage tourism product: Route “Roman frontier within the cross-border region Romania-Bulgaria”. 

Total project budget: 961,747.88 Euro.

titleEn: Joint initiatives and solutions in addressing emergency situations in the cross border area
summaryEn:
One of the major issues addressed by the project is represented by the inability of Muncipality of DrobetaTurnuSeverin to alarm properly it’s population in case of emergency situations due to the old existing system which is impracticable and does not offer an appropriate alarming coverage for the entire city.
Another major problem is represented by their lack of proper specific intervention vehicles, machineries and equipment, from the both partners. Also an important problem identified to the target groups in that the two communities don’t have a good knowledge of the risks they might face in the area in which they live, the prevention measure and the behavior they should adopt in case of different emergency situations. The objective to improve joint risk management in the cross-border area will be achieved through the following activities: Acquisition of an alarming system and specific vehicles, machineries and equipment; Awareness raisingto the target groups concerning emergency situations through provided informational materials; conducting seminars and awareness campaigns for the target groups. The results of the project will be: 1 achieved alarm system, vehicles, machineries and equipment purchased, at least 5,000 people informed on emergency situations theme, 1 joint study on risk management in the border area, 117.353 beneficiary inhabitants of the joint risk management, 1 long term joint emergency situations partnership. Information added on 2020-05-11, regarding the mitigation of the effects of COVID-19 (the corona virus pandemic that started in 2019) (English language only): Project ROBG-122 helps against spreading of Covid-19, by providing for use 5 modular containers purchased within the project ROBG-122, "Joint initiatives and solutions in addressing emergency situations in the cross border area", in order to quarantine the persons who return from countries affected by COVID -19 through the customs of Mehedinti county.

titleEn: Development of the River Danube for better connectivity of the Euroregion Ruse-Giurgiu with Pan-European transport corridor №7
summaryEn:
Ruse municipality and Giurgiu municipality, in partnership, created this project to be with focus on establishment of measures for well-connected common cross-border region with safety transport on waterways. The project presents a complex of activities, which are addressing to ensure safety transport through the improvement of waterways in Danube river.

Thus a better water infrastructure will be achieved which is pledge for overcoming the unsatisfactory condition of the current one.

Overview of the total area

The partners aim to achieve the overall objective through implementation of measures as follows:

1. Giurgiu Municipality will implement construction of a quay in Giurgiu municipality, through arrangement of a sector of Channel Sfantul Gheorghe, near the natural link with Danube, in order to improve connectivity with the pan-European corridor for waterway transport.

2. Ruse Municipality will realize rehabilitation of the piers of the passenger terminal Ruse center and improving the navigation conditions of the three berths.

Thus a revitalization of the transport water infrastructure between Giurgiu and Ruse will be achieved. These main activities will result in establishment of good conditions for safety transport through the improvement of waterways in between the partners.

The estimated project budget is 7 973 261,83euro.

titleEn: Linking TEN through better connection between tertiary nodes Turnu Magurele and Levski for sustainable development of the area
summaryEn:
The challenges addressed by L-TeN project are: under-developed road infrastructure with a high risk of accidents and, as a consequence, to increased travelling times, vehicle operating costs, accidents and damage to the environment. Turnu Magurele is crossed by five NRs and the traffic is increasing. When the beltway (which is collecting traffic from 3 NRs) is overcrowded in order to optimize the time, the five roads targeted by L-TeN project are used to avoid it and to go to Pleven via Nikopole and Levski which is a crossing point for 7 NRs connected with TENT network and E83. The road targeted by L-TeN project is in a poor condition too. General objective is to improve the connection among core and comprehensive TEN-T networks using the tertiary nodes Turnu Magurele and Levski as „bridgeheads” for connection and joint transport system. The specific objectives are: to improve the transport infrastructure; to develop a joint traffic management system and to capitalize the local expertise on traffic safety measures. 

The main activities are: elaboration of technical documents, works execution, set-up traffic management system and safety traffic measures and awareness campaign. The total budget is 4,676,286.31 euro. The expected result is: 23,427 population will be served. 2 joint mechanisms will be created. L-TeN will improve the connection of Levski with E83, Danube as European corridor VII  and future Hemus with E70 and secondary nodes Craiova and Giurgiu via Turnu Magurele.

titleEn: A heritage-friendly cross-border economy in Romania and Bulgaria
summaryEn:
The project objective is to facilitate a common approach on the sustainable use of cultural and natural heritage, in order to determine the growth and creation of jobs in the border area RO–BG, by improving tourism sector.

The project tackles the concept of heritage-friendly economy and it main results are:

- An assumed cross-border strategy for developing a heritage-friendly economy – a framework for guiding, volunteer regulation and recognition of sustainably using natural and cultural.

- An implementation framework covering the RO and BG chambers of commerce and other business support organisation along the border to be involved in the Strategy implementation, including trainings for their experts, and production of various implementation tools.

- A pilot implementation phase including an information and educational campaign targeting local business communities in Constanta and Dobrich, pilot training sessions and recognition.

Main activities:

- Elaboration of the Strategy for developing of a heritage-friendly business environment,

- Establishment of the Strategy implementation frame for CCIs and other business associations,

- Pilot implementation actions of the Strategy in Constanta and Dobrich areas,

- Visibility and publicity of the project.

- Project management

Total budget:  348.373,44 euro, of which eligible value from ERDF 296.117,43 euro.

titleEn: Capabilities and interoperability for joint Romanian-Bulgarian cross-border first responder intervention to chemical-biological-radiological- nuclear–high yield explosive
summaryEn:
The project addresses the need for enhancement of response and recovery capabilities of emergency services, derived from the recent national legislations. It aims at improving specific field activities conducted by specialized Police structures immediately after an event implying chemical-biological-radiological-nuclear-high yield explosives (CBRNe).

With 5.999.763,78 EUR funding, the project strategic objective  is to set-up in Romania-Bulgaria cross-border area a fully interoperable, rapid reaction system to CBRNe emergencies, able to provide/accept services from both parts and to effectively use them to the benefit of the whole area population.

Identical mobile equipment will be provided to CBRNe police intervention  units  from both border sides, enabling them to collect data to characterize the situation in terms of event type, amplitude and responsibility, while gaining control of situation and securing the area. Rapid detection devices of CBR contaminants will be provided along with means for data transfer to emergency management authorities, enabling an adequate and effective response. Dedicated equipment for analyses of samples collected by operative units will be used by LB to produce the required assessments for evaluation and mitigation of longer term effects.

Thus, the project provides means of E.C. Decision 2008/617/JHA implementation for cross-border cooperation between specialintervention units, realizing an integrated regional management of CBRNe emergencies.

titleEn: Joint risk prevention and management system for Gradinari – Malu - Byala communities for a safe and developed cross-border region
summaryEn:
The project is addressing the effects of the climate change upon the environment of Byala, Malu and Gradinari cross-border communities, and the lack of coordination, planning & risk mitigation capacity registered at the beneficiaries’ level. Therefore, the project is aiming at increasing the quality of the common risk management in these communities, in relation with the progress of coordination of the management of decisions and intervention at county/ district level. The total budget of the project is 718.048,55 euro.

The project activities are: Information and Publicity; Creating a joint system for  risk management; Joint elaboration of a Guidelines for common management of natural hazards and other emergency situations; Improving the logistics for risk management in Gradinari, Malu  and Byala communities; Joint applications in floods, fire and winter-related natural hazards; Awareness campaign on risk management in Byala, Gradinari, Malu; Establishing a joint partnership in the field of early warning and risk management; Project management.

The project will improve the joint risk management in target area through increasing the tactical and operational levels of coordination, enhancing the joint work, equipment and human resources, along with raising awareness among communities upon preparedness and prevention of risk situations. Moreover, the project will contribute to the creation of a joint partnership in the field of early warning and risk management.

titleEn: Innovative and collaborative  management of Natura 2000 sites in the Danube border region
Development of an information network to ease the cooperation between public authorities, NGOs, business and citizens in the cross-border region Bulgaria-Romania
summaryEn:
The overall attitude to Romanian and Bulgarian public authorities is largely negative and most public services offered are cumbersome, time and resource – consuming. In today’s fast and technologic world, it is extremely important to respond quickly and offer one-stop-shop services and electronic ones.

The main objective of the project is to establish an efficient and effective innovative tool for better cooperation/ coordination among public and private stakeholders at cross-border level. The budget resources will be used for value-for-money solutions in order to fulfil the objective, the project outputs and results.

The foreseen activities include a detailed study and analysis, the development of an online platform and a public-private network for better cooperation, the elaboration of a strategy and a lot of informational activities. The online platform will be used for presenting the activities of the public authorities in a more accessible, transparent and easy to use way and enable them to interact more successfully among themselves and with the non-public sector.

Other tangible results will be the cooperation agreements signed between interested stakeholders, the detailed study of the needs and problems, the opportunities and the measures to be taken to solve existing problems or prevent new ones, the elaborated strategy for future operation of the platform and the E-GovNet network of public and non-public entities, which will all lead to better coordination.

titleEn: Developing an integrated and inclusive labor market at cross-border level
summaryEn:
A large number of citizens in the cross-border area are affected by skills shortage phenomenon with direct effect on their employment opportunities. Other part are low skilled workers that cannot integrate on labor market because they don’t have the possibility to improve these skills. Most of these people have educational gaps and theirs abilities doesn’t correspond to the current market labor supply and demand model. They don’t have access to information, access to relevant training programs and aren’t supported for integration on labor market. A large part of them are exposed to the risk to be socially excluded, especially disadvantaged categories. Private companies eithers are focused on low-income business models in the CBC area and cannot grow, aren’t create smart jobs for skilled people; either have problems in finding skilled workforce for their sector of activity.

The project general objective is to support the CBC integration of employment and labor mobility as a common “market” through creating CBC LABORLAB Model that will realize future skills forecasts, develop operational structures and joint vocational training programs capable to integrate CBC labor market in a flexible environment. For achieving project objective a CBC LABORLAB Model will be developed. In the first phase a research study will be realized and a forecasting model (skills, labor market evolution, economic evolution) will be developed. In the second phase 4 joint vocational training programs will be developed to cover basic skills, critical skills and language skills gap. These training programs will be delivered to 480 participants from CBC area. In the third phase CBC LABORLAB Cluster will be build with legal entity, 3 departments: Information Center, Advice Center and Talent Mobility Center, and equipped with 3 software applications that will be developed through the project: Job Matching App, FUTURE SKILLS APP and Portal APP. In the fourth phase information campaigns will be organized and a strategy for employment and social inclusion of disadvantaged people will be elaborated. In the fifth phase publicity and visibility actions will be developed and implemented. Project actions will be coordinated through project management activities. Project budget is: 723.193,52 Euro. 

Main results: 1 innovative labor market integration model developed – CBC LABORLAB; 4 new “market approach” training programs developed with 480 participants – basic skills training programs, critical skills training program; language skill training program & transversal issues training programme; 1 legal support structure for labor market integration and labor mobility created – CBC LABORLAB CLUSTER;  3 innovative applications for labor market integration and labor mobility developed and used for at least 1600 participants at joint employment initiatives.

titleEn: Integrated Multimedia Platform for Active Culture and Tourism
summaryEn:
Tourism is one of the strong assets of the CBC region in terms of employment and turnover in services but suffer hard seasonal appearance and fragile market unequally split between the Black Sea cost and the unexploited rest of the territory.

To tackle this problem IMPACT project aims to promote the CBC area as an attractive tourist destination on the basis of sustainable use of natural and cultural resources through innovative and interactive IT solutions for provision of tourist services.

Main activities and results that are envisaged to achieve these objective are:

Create wide spatial data base of cultural, natural and historical sites on the territory of entire CBC area;

Develop an innovative and interactive online GIS based platform for provision of information and tourist services;

Unite minimum 5 complex tourist routes for the entire CBC area – culture & history, nature & sport, religion, rural tourism and wine & gourmet.

Once having recognized the CBC area as an attractive area of new destinations, the tourists will increase their number of visits as well as the duration of their stay and the area will become main tourist location but not supplementary like up t now.  As a result, it is expected in 5 years after the project completion the number of overnights on the CBC area to increase with 100 000 and the number of visits to supported sites of cultural and natural heritage and attraction - with 2 500.

The total budget of the project is estimated to 1 492 329,36  EUR.

titleEn: Cross Border virtual incubator for promoting employment on bio agriculture, bio products processing and connected services
summaryEn:
RMQ and NCIS join their experience on project BIOVIRTINC addressed to population of cross border area Dolj Pleven, rural and unemployed, students and graduated specialist in agriculture. Facing the same challenges such as major high share of agriculture, low standard of life and low education in rural, migration to urban, unemployment, project objective is to encourage integration of the cross-border area Dolj Pleven in terms of employment, labour mobility, business development in the field of bio agriculture, bio products processing and connected services using a budget of……EU. 

Within project is created virtual incubator BIOVIRTINC, activities including information, trainings, consultancy for certification of bio producers and products, business and mobility tools tailored to the specific needs of job seekers and entrepreneurs rising in the process of labor market inclusion. Employment initiatives consist of activities that stimulates new business and job creation on bio field by informing and educating CB population, buyers, farmers, producers, interconnecting on Business and Mobility tools, help desk, providing free soil analyses for starting certification, marketing. Expected results: 315 persons trained, 5000 platform users, 200 job seekers/specialists, 30 employers/entrepreneurs, 10 land owners; 100 consultancy for certification;population informed and award on business/employment opportunities on bio field, 240 from direct meetings,137444 from radio/TV, 8000 from flyers.

titleEn: Innovative practices and services in education
Cross-border Labour Mobility Agency
summaryEn:
The project addresses common challenges of the CBC region:

Lack of evidence as to the main factors impeding but also promoting CBC labour mobility in the CBC area;
Lack of services for labour mobility;
Lack of institutions to support personal capacity for CBC employment;
No EURES partnership in the CBC Romania – Bulgaria area;
Hard accessibility.

The main objective is to contribute to the integration of the CBC area in terms of employment and labour mobility. Its specific objective is to foster CBC employment and labour mobility through establishing a one-stop-shop with information and services.

The project’s activities:
A1 Project preparation,
A2 Project management,
A3 Project information, communication and publicity,
A4 Study on employment and labour mobility,
A5 Establishing the VISA Labour Mobility Agency,
A6 Visa Agency Portfolio of integrated instruments,
A7 Pilot actions for cross-border mobility - Info & Training,
A8 Pilot actions for cross-border mobility – “Lets Commute”,
A9 Pilot Consultation sessions,
A10 Sustaining the project results.

Total budget: 539 157.69  EUR

Expected results:
VISA Labour Mobility Agency established;
services for employment and mobility ensured;
experts to facilitate labour mobility trained;
sustainability of VISA Agency guaranteed.

They contribute to the program’s results indicator “Population that have access to joint employment initiatives”, since the project supports working age population of the CBC region by enhancing its employability and labour mobility.

titleEn: INVESTMENTS FOR A SAFE REGION: GIURGIU COUNTY AND RUSE DISTRICT
summaryEn:
The lack of proper logistics means for the management of emergency situations in Gr Ru CB area can generate low efficiency. Currently, at our level, rescue missions of victims from hostile environments lacks important means and the missions of the inspectorates are undertaken with improvised tools: no polygon for the training of staff and no specialized equipments. Also, there’s no space to preserve in optimal conditions vehicles and the repair of vehicles is made contracting private operators with high costs. There are no self-maintenance actions made over equipments. During the long duration missions, the fleet of the inspectorates can suffer blockages which cannot be eliminated using their existing non-mobile resources.

ISR will help the two inspectorates with two construction investments and new equipments: for research and evaluation of risks, for hostile environments rescuing (from heights, in case of landslides and captivity in ruins and specific risks -Seveso - First intervention truck equipped with fire cutting extinguisher).

ISR will provide superior technical conditions by implementing investments over a period of 36 months, that will have a major positive impact on the response speed of the emergency activities and missions in Giurgiu-Ruse region and with a budget of approximately 6 million euro.

The objectives will be achieved through the main activities: Project preparation; Project Management, Procurements, Technical documentation, Construction works and endowments; Information and publicity, Events, Trainings.

ISR will result in a higher quality of joint risk in the CBC area benefiting to approx. 515.000 inhabitants of Giurgiu County and Ruse District due to improved actions in risk management and other safety tools.

titleEn: Romanian Bulgarian Organic- Entrepreneurial Network
summaryEn:
The project “Romanian Bulgarian Organic- Entrepreneurial Network” (RBOEN) is addressed to encouraging yet low-rated  Entrepreneurial  and labour activities among people in the cross-border area of Constanta-Dobrich, in particular those interested in organic food production, its delivery and promotion and thus giving a chance of start-ups or existing business to develop a niche, crucial for sustainable economic development of the region.

The project envisages achieving stronger cross-border partnership and cooperation through establishment of RBOENetwork; raising awareness of employment opportunities and Entrepreneurship in the area of organic food through the Web portal “Cross-Border Nature-Friendly Entrepreneurs” and organized training sessions; increasing the collaboration and partnership with education institutions to organize up-to-date trainings that meet the challenges of new business and demands of labour market and increasing the attractiveness of the border area through joint Organic festival “The gifts of Nature”. The project results in a number initiatives aiming to establish common business interests, common markets, including labour one as a stepping stone to the mid-long term sustainable growth and development of the cross-border region of Constanta (Romania) and Dobrich (Bulgaria) regions.  

The budget of the action is 136232.63EUR.

titleEn: Risk management and flood protection in cross-border regions Calarasi and Polski Trambesh
summaryEn:
The project addresses the problem of emergency situations, mainly floods but also all kinds of natural and man made hazards potentially harmful to the environment such as: traffic accidents (e.g. involving tank trucks loaded with dangerous substances which should be immediately removed), unexploded ammunition (which by accidental explosion in case of mishandeling could cause disasters to environment and human life).

In what concerns the floods, they are extremely dangerous in both regions envisaged by the project. In Polski Trambesh there are numerous floods on the Yantra river and its tributary Elija. In Calarasi County, more than 1,000 interventions of Inspectorate for Emergency Situations took place over the past 10 years while the overall damage caused by floods in the region amounts to millions of euros.

The main problem blocking an effective mitigation of those consequences is the lack of a modern system for forecasting and early warning of flood events.

The project main objective is to improve the joint risk management in the cross-border region.

The main activities are related to Setting up the Flood Forecasting and Early Warning System in Polski Trambesh, setting up an emergency management system (including early warning and respons actions) in Calarasi County (the system will include an Information System and specialized equipment) and joint activities (exercises and concluding an Action plan).

The result of the project will be a better protection of environment and population in the cross-border are against the natural and man-made hazards, thus contributing to the achievement of programme indicators for PA 3.

titleEn: 6 Reasons to Visit Mehedinti-Vidin cross-border Area
summaryEn:
The project’s central aim is to promote tourism in close connection to environmental protection and to provide solutions for cross-border labour market development.

Objectives:

1. The contribution to the economical, social and cultural sustainable development of the Mehedinti-Vidin CBC area by means of joint actions focused on the touristic infrastructure, respectively the common design of key tourism products and services based on the natural and cultural heritage.

2. Raising the relevant comunities awareness concerning the Mehedinti-Vidin area’s cultural and natural heritage riches aiming at present appreciation and future preservation.

3. The establishment of a solid and lasting partnership between Mehedinti county and Vidin region as an instrument of sustainable Romanian-Bulgarian crossborder cooperation aiming at overcoming the physical and socio-cultural barriers and at a better attainment of the opportunities intrinsically generated.

The total budget of the operation is 422.192,98 €.

The project’s first foreseen result is a tourism marketing study that will underpin the performance of all the project’s activities. It will be the starting point for the achievement of a travel guide and a travel map, 6 promotional films,1 website, the participation at 6 national tourism fairs both in Bulgaria and Romania and for the project’s overall advertising activities.

The envisaged awareness actions, jointly designed and implemented, will focus on issues like heritage conservation and its preservation for future generations: 16 information seminars, 6 handicraft workshops, 1  cultural festival (further referred to as “Creation Festival”) and 1 RO-BG conference.

The project’s results contribute to the achieving of the program’s output and result indicators: 1 Touristic Marketing Study, 4000 Travel guides, 4000 Tourtistic maps,6 souvenirs designs, 6 films, 6 touristic routes, 1 website, 6 participations at national tourism fairs, 6 information seminars,6 handicraft workshops, 4000 Craftsmen Books,1 Creation Festival, 1 Conference.

titleEn: BORDERLESS HEALTH THROUGH SPORT AND COOPERATION – UNITED IN THE BATTLE AGAINST DISEASES
summaryEn:
Preventing diseases and improving health through physical and therapeutic activities is an imperative of the European and national health policies. At the level of cross-border communities, these policies are “timid” or nonexistent, with negative economic and social consequences, sedentary lifestyle being globally recognized as a major factor for premature death and disease, and social exclusion for persons with disabilities being a factor of social imbalance with negative effects in the sustainable development. Thus, the project aims to increase efficiently the cooperation between local public administrations/governments in the cross-border area Harsova – Shabla, in services on public health focused on prevention and improvement actions. 

The project proposes new approaches through concrete actions that offer the Romanian-Bulgarian communities facilities for physical exercises to prevent diseases and maintain a state of optimal health throughout life.The new approaches integrate investments in upgrading infrastructure (SPORT FIELD -STADIUM and LOCKER ROOM in HARSOVA TOWN and a SPORT HALL/REHABILITATION CENTER in SHABLA MUNICIPALITY) with investments information, motivation and awareness actions aimed at changing mentalities and attitudes among the population in the cross-border area for increasing physical activities in everyday life for optimum and sustainable health. Medium and long term project results can be translated into savings in the public health system and increased capacity of the workforce. The project proposes an innovative policy that enhances cross-border cooperation and the coordination level of public institutions in the field of public health policies focused on preventing diseases and improving health.

titleEn: Cross-Border Partnership for Training and Labour mobility in the Juridical field
summaryEn:
The issues to which the project addresses are: the high youth unemployment rate, the legal professionals’ low wages, the brain-drain phenomenon and the lack of linkages between education institutions and employers represent current issues within the area aimed for by the project.

The objective of the project is to encourage the integration of the cross-border area regarding employment and workforce mobility in the juridical field, in county Dolj and district Vidin, via cooperation and promotion of joint actions of beneficiaries, by using human and natural resources in a sustainable manner.

The budget of the project: 468.487,64 EUR.

The objective will be achieved by means of the activities listed below:

-creation of a network of centers,

-development of a joint study,

-drafting of a joint strategy,

-organization of two cross-order conferences,

-development of two special foreign language courses,

-development of joint training courses in the juridical field,

-organization of several joint training  sessions regarding the importance of the horizontal themes,

-achievement of exchanges of experience with model transfer and good practice solutions.

Results of the project:

-a network of Cross-Border Juridical Centers,

-a website with data base,

-a joint study,  

-a joint cross-border strategy, 

-two cross-border conferences,

-two foreign language courses,  

-six courses on juridical themes,

-two joint training sessions on horizontal themes,

-two exchanges of good practices.

titleEn: Safe Schools Network
summaryEn:
To build disaster resistant communities means to involve whole population of the process of risk reduction, not only responsible institutions and experts. In this context very important group are young people, because in one side they are potential victims in disastrous events, but for other – future resource for disaster protection.

The main aim of the project is to raising awareness in the field of efficient risk prevention trough formal and informal education of children and youth in border area (Vidin and Montana districts, Bulgaria and Dolj county, Romania). The way to achieve this aim is through creation of an international network of “Safe schools”, educational institutions who put in focus disaster protection and who collaborate in this field and share good practices. Project is oriented to whole school community – school management, teachers, psychologists, and students. The budget of the proposal is 290 930,58 euro.

Project activates: Promotion of the project in area to attract participation; Research of needs and resources; International meetings of experts; Development of methodical materials; Web-site development; Implementation of training sessions for school management, teachers and psychologists in both countries; Work of volunteer clubs inside target schools; Implementation of national and international competitions between school voluntary units; Closing forum for dissemination of results; Publications and publicity; Project management.

The main result will be 20 schools better prepared for disaster events, which means around 10 000 students, teachers and other staff better protected. In other side the model “Safe School” is also a valuable contribution to the quality of school risk management in the CBC area, because it has potential for multiplication as a good practice. The project will also contribute for development of disaster protection volunteering, using of new methods for motivation trough linking formal and informal education, creating a web-based “community of practice”, networking, etc.

titleEn: Society for All Ages
summaryEn:
SAGE project it`s not an investement project and even so,with minimal costs and maximal sustainability,it`s overall objective is to strengthen social and economic cohesion in the rural area of Constanta county,by altering the structure of the active population and generating a pool of labor recruitment,for medium and long term.

The specific objectives are aiming,on the one hand, to reduce occupational incompatibility of supply and demand of jobs,due to the precarious level of the education, as a hinder factor for mobility of labour,and,on the other hand,to correlate the supply and demand of rural work force amid an accentuated process of aging population.

Project`s value is 435.448,99€ and main activities are:project management, information&publicity campaign,project identity campaign,Training Center, development of a Strategy for employment of labor force and social inclusion in rural areas, development of vocational trainings along with foreign languages and IT trainings, 2 Cooperation Agreements between Labour Agencies in the partner regions, creating a web-based resources network among the stakeholders, 2 study visits,2 joint promotional events for the action partners and target group.

The target group consists of rural population fit to work from partner regions, employers and NGOs acting in the field of social protection and health services, local, regional and national public authorities.

The results of the project address all 3 of the output indicators of the  Programme.

titleEn: Community Opposition of Disastrous Events
summaryEn:
The statistics show big deficits in voluntary units for disaster protection:  Bulgaria (0.29 volunteers per 1,000 inhabitants), Romania (6.91); the leading countries such as Austria - 32.47. There still stay the question not only to increase number of volunteers, but also for education of the existing units.

The main objective of the project is to increase local capacity in rural areas of Romania-Bulgaria border region (regions of Dolj in Romania, Vidin and Montana in Bulgaria) for disasters’ prevention and mitigation trough development of extended volunteer units and their better preparation, including in a cross-border context.  This means to involve in risk management not only existing voluntary units, but also other relevant human resources, available in the target communities, such as for example social and health workers, psychologists, etc. The budget of the project is 294,194.22 euro.

Project activates: Promotion of the project in area to attract participation; Research of needs and resources; International meetings of experts; Development of methodical materials; Web-site development; Implementation of 54 training sessions in both countries; Implementation of two joint practical exercises; Closing forum; Publications and publicity; Project management.

The main result will be 20 rural communities (municipalities) better prepared for disaster events’ opposition, which means around 64 000 inhabitants better protected and a valuable contribution to the quality of the joint risk management in the CBC area. The result will be achieved through extended the number of potential volunteers with 120 and including in training under joint methodology of 480 representatives of project target groups.

titleEn: Rapid intervention force to chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear emergencies on the Danube river
summaryEn:
To rapidly and efficiently manage the chemical-biological-nuclear emergencies (CBRN) on the Danube river, the Romanian-Bulgarian emergency authorities are setting up in the cross-border area a joint intervention rapid force, D-EMERSYS, resulting from interconnection of 2 specialized units, the on-the water reaction unit provided to Romanian emergency authorities and the on-the land support unit provided to Bulgarian emergency authorities. Both units will act coordinated under the command of the authority from the country where the intervention is taking place. The core of on-the-water reaction unit are 3 rapid CBRN intervention boats equipped with capabilities for in-situ detection  of  contaminants  and devices for decontamination of floating structures and fire-extinguishing/contaminant cloud dispersal. The land-based unit comprises 5 specialized mobile CBRN platforms provided with capabilities for analyses of CBRN toxic elements from water, soil and air, as well as with devices for decontamination of both intervention personnel and technique. Further specialized analyses of contaminants will be performed by a new “environmental forensic” laboratory set-up by LB.

With 5.995.156,46 € funding, the project will also deliver the training for intervention personnel and will prepare the tools required by the legal framework for the operationalization of D-EMERSYS, establishing a strong partnership on Danube river CBRN emergency response, for the benefit of population and environment.

titleEn: Plums For Junk

Investigation of opportunities for reducing the TEN-T network use within the cross-border region Romania-Bulgaria through optimization of the freight and passenger transport and the development of a joint mechanism for support of the intermodal connections
summaryEn:
The proposed project addresses problems of accessibility, efficiency, ecology and safety of secondary/tertiary nodes connection to TEN-T infrastructure in the cross-border region.

The main objective of the proposed action is to significantly improve the planning, development and coordination of cross-border transport systems for better connections with TEN-T network in the CBC area. This is done through investment in the study, planning and adoption of strategic documents on optimizing of the transport system through enhanced intermodal transport connections in the cross-border region. Total project budget: 1,469,150.61 Euro.

The main activities within the Project are elaboration of a common preliminary study on intermodal nodes’ current state and their capability to enhance the TEN-T network in the CBC area, and a common strategy on TEN-T network enhancement through improving intermodal nodes’ capacity. The study and strategy are developed with organization of 8 round tables. Thus, the project creates a joint mechanism to facilitate the connection of secondary/tertiary nodes to TEN-T infrastructure in the CBC area

The Project will attain the following results: 1 preliminary study on intermodal nodes’ current state and their capability to enhance the TEN-T network within the CBC area, 1 common strategy on TEN-T network enhancement through improving intermodal nodes’ capacity, and 8 round tables.

titleEn: Building a sustainable model and partner network to support employment and labour mobility in the cross border area Bulgaria-Romania
summaryEn:
The project addresses important common challenges related to labour market and quality employment in the RO-BR cross-border area as: high rate of unemployment in the targeted area, imbalance between the demand and supply of workforce, inadequate educational system to the employer’ needs, lack of integrated labour market in the cross border area. 

The project main objective is to encourage the labour mobility in key economic sectors in the cross border area through creating conditions for balance between demand and supply on the labour market. The estimated budget for implementing the proposed activities is 727 478,27 euro. It will be developed useful tools which will give information about the labour market and the potential economic sector for labour mobility as well as profiles of the most attractive enterprises which can invest in new job positions; give an opportunity to check the necessary skills and competences for a given profession in an economic sector through developed competence catalogues; help in competence assessment of the employees and the potential workers through e-tools for competence assessment; assist in improving skills and competences through set of e-training courses, including language courses; The expected results are: Created conditions for a balance between supply and demand of work in the RO-BG cross border area; Created conditions for sustainable jobs through developing e-training courses compliant to the employer needs;  Encouraged labour mobility;

titleEn: Advertising of Regional Cultural Heritage in 3D
summaryEn:
The economies of Balchik and Mangalia are significantly dependent on the seasonal tourist flow. Both partners are in need of an innovative way to advertise their rich cultural heritage to attract tourists throughout the entire year.

The ARCH 3D projects intents to tackle the abovementioned problem by improving the sustainable use of sites of cultural heritage in the area.

The abovementioned goal will be achieved by the Development of promotional 3D videos, an innovative instrument to advertise the cultural and historic heritage of the region. Launching events will be organized in Balchik and Mangalia, on which the elaborated videos will be presented. Further attention to the project will be drawn by presenting the 3D videos on the facades of sites of cultural heritage on both sides of the border. A common plan for advertising of cultural heritage in the cross-border region of the two municipalities will be elaborated. Two exhibition halls in Mangalia and Balchik will be established, in which the promotional videos will be presented on a year-round basis.

The implementation of the project will result in an increase in the number of tourist overnights in the CBC region and in the tourist visits to sites of cultural heritage and in the elaboration of a common plan for advertising the cultural heritage for sustainable economic uses, thus contributing to the Programme indicator “Increase in expected number of visits to supported sites of cultural and natural heritage and attraction”.

titleEn: Green School Education as a Promotion of Sustainable Use of Cultural and Natural Heritage and Resources
summaryEn:
The project strategy core is to bring together CBC communities as a first step towards new tourist product /named Green School Education - GSE/ development on the Montana district territory and a Tourist Information Center /TIC/ establishment in Craiova, RO to promote common tourist potential and integrated tourist services. The reason for the project proposing at GSE development and TIC establishment is based on the statistic data /2014/ indicating that only 2.3 % of all overnights /21698391 totally in BG/ and only 0.4% of these spent by foreigners /14077798 totally in BG/ are located in BG North-West. The Montana district territory is defined because, although available accommodation facilities at high level and significant tourist attractions, the nights spend by foreigners are even at least – among overnights spent by foreigners in all districts of North-West /56308 totally/ Montana has only 4909, Vidin -10390, Vratsa-11 860, Lovech-14 108, Pleven-15041.

The project proposes at three objectives to promote more sustainable use of Montana and Dolj natural heritage and resources and cultural heritage: PO1 is to be developed and promoted a new CBC tourist product named GSE on the territory of Montana district, BG based on integrated tourist services; PO2 is to be established TIC in Craiova, RO to provide integrated services and PO3 is to be promoted the common potential of Montana and Dolj districts for a better tourist stream through elaboration and broadcasting 20 films, radio adds, catalogues, educational and promotional materials etc. The total project budget is 693 904.93 EUR.

Main project activities: Production and broadcasting of 20 /twenty/ 15-minute Eng-BG-RO educational-information films promoting the cultural and natural heritage of Montana and Dolj districts; Organization and carrying out of a 5-day course of GSE /in BG/ per each of three target groups of pupils /three courses totally/ – up to 12 years old, up to 14 years old and up to 16 years old; Establishment of TIC in Craiova, RO; Organization of a three-day Teachers Forum in RO; Production of promotional catalogues, materials and articles for GSE directed to the target groups;

Project main results expected are: a new tourist CBC integrated product named Green Schools Education developed on the territory of Montana district, BG; a Tourist Information Center established in Craiova, RO; minimum 20 sites in Montana and Dolj CBC region promoted as segments of common tourist potential; increasing the number of visits to minimum 20 sites promoted in the CBC region of Montana and Dolj. All numbered results are fully related to the Program indicators as follows: increasing the growth on numbers of overnights /Program result indicator under PA2, SO 2.1/, with minimum 3000 overnights on the territories of Montana and Dolj districts /compared to the baseline on the beginning of 2014/; Increase with 100 in expected number of visits to supported sites /20/ of cultural and natural heritage and attraction (COI) /Program output under PA2, SO 2.1/; Number of integrated tourism products/services created /Program output under PA2, SO 2.1/. Finally, the awareness of cultural identity and the encouragement and keeping correctly-environmental sparing manners as a green solution under traditional education of young people is an integrated part of the project strategy.

titleEn: Development and adoption of a joint institutionalized partnership on risk management on excessive proliferation of insects affecting public health and safety within the cross-border region Romania-Bulgaria
summaryEn:
There is a great public health risk, posed by the high proliferation and spread of mosquitoes, ticks and other insects in the CBC area, namely, outbreak of exotic diseases and epidemics.  To mitigate and manage this risk, a new integrated mechanism of control over insect population has to be set up and a strategy for the joint risk management developed.

The main objective of the proposed action is to significantly improve joint risk management in the target region through development of a joint institutionalized partnership. 

Total project budget: 1,428,412.92 Euro.

First, the proposed action is to elaborate a preliminary study of the conditions in the target area and to identify the risk zones, to study the best practices of joint control over insect population in conditions close to the CBC area, to produce a GIS of the treated territories. Second, a Strategy is elaborated to ensure sustainable practice of insect treatment and organizational measures. In implementation of the Strategy, a joint partnership of early warning and of disinsection in the CBC area is set up.

The Project will attain the following results: 1 joint institutionalized partnership on insect population management, 1 preliminary study on the risk of increase in insect population, 1 common strategy on control over insect population, 2 surveys on the quality of joint risk management, 1 GIS on control over insect population, and 14 round tables and 1 conference.

titleEn: Integrated employment interventions in the Border Cooperation Region, Giurgiu - Ruse
summaryEn:
The project “Integrated employment interventions in the Border Cooperation Region, Giurgiu - Ruse” will be realized in more phases.

In the first phase will be realized a study to identify measures for better correlation between the individual skills, education, employment potential and opportunities in the labor market from region Giurgiu – Ruse.

Through this study will be determined the amount of assistance needs and  indicators content (specifying the needs and priorities of information, advice and training, concrete methods of increasing the employment of the inactive population in the labor market, domains and sectors for suitable business development, strengths and weaknesses in the labor market).

After the study will be realized two Regional  Resource Centers for Employment (RRCE) will be established one in Giurgiu and the second one in Ruse;

In the second phase for 500 persons will be provided services in an integrated program to headquarter of RRCE. After the program will be provided, 250 persons out of 500 will enter into training courses in order to adapt qualifications to labor market needs. Moreover entrepreneurial, English and IT courses will be held.

In order to increase mobility rate two job fairs will be realized and an IT platform for labor mobility will be developed.

titleEn: Coordination of joint policies and equipment investments in the field of education in the cross-border area
summaryEn:
The cross-border area benefits from an important advantage, the human resources, which is insufficiently valued. The project is addressing the poor education infrastructure (laboratory equipment, IT tools, etc.) in the Bulgarian and Romanian high-schools, not allowing the students to discover their full potential. Another identified problem is the lack of correlation between the Bulgarian and Romanian educational systems, although it is obvious both countries would benefit from a partnership in this field, resulting in greater opportunities for the children. The project will implement the MaST (Mathematics, Science and Technologies) concept in creating and equipping MaST Innovation and Creativity Studyshops (MICS) in high-schools from Bulgaria and Romania, establishing MaST competitions and developing the joint mechanisms for these cross-border activities.

The estimated budget for the entire project is almost €1,2 mil., split between 4 beneficiaries, while the main activities will consist in creating and equipping the MICS, establishing and holding cross-border competitions in the field of MaST education, study visits, information activities in order to promote the MICS concept.

The proposed result of the project is to achieve a stronger level of coordination between the educational institutions in the cross-border area, not just the ones involved in the project. The outputs of the project will consist in 12 supported cross-border mechanisms.

titleEn: Heightened Information and Resources for Employability Development
summaryEn:
The Romanian-Bulgarian cross-border area (CBA) displays high unemployment and inactivity rates. At the same time, managers in the region complain about difficulties in finding qualified workforce. This points to labour market mismatches and signals the need to better correlate education with existing and future job opportunities. The HIRED project addresses this issue through joint research and educational initiatives that offer a comprehensive solution. 

We aim to (1) enhance the information about labour market demand through forecasting research; (2) provide joint training in 3 growing sectors of the market, enabling 300 CBA citizens to gain skills and obtain qualifications in Entrepreneurship, Sales and Project Management; (3) build a sustainable eLearning platform that will: raise awareness about lifelong learning, provide tools for developing transversal skills (through 14 tutorials on subjects such as communication, durable development, creativity, diversity etc.), stimulate mobility by offering Bulgarian & Romanian language courses, and inform CBA citizens about fiscal & legal issues regarding work on the other side of the border. 

These activities are complemented by support & dissemination actions: 2 conferences to present research results to relevant stakeholders and 2 job & education fairs for facilitating links between employers, training providers and jobseekers. 

The project will require a budget of 604507,22 and result in 4 initiatives that will increase employability and mobility in CBA.

titleEn: E-bike Net
summaryEn:
Project “E-bike Net” addresses the issue of sustainable individual transport mobility. The current structure of the transport infrastructure in the cross-border area is very centralized, connecting smaller towns with the center, thus neglecting the connections between the smaller towns themselves, especially the towns along the Danube and between the 2 countries. Furthermore, public transport could never have the flexibility to provide in the district towns the means of transport for the wanted destination at any moment and without changing different vehicles.

We aim to create and promote a network of electrical bicycles, which people can use to move freely in the whole cross-border area of Bulgaria and Romania using the current road network or some dirt roads and to be able to charge the bicycles in a range of up to 70 kilometers throughout the cbc area.

The budget for our operation is 768 392,92 euro.

Project activities will be: study for e-bike network; preparation and creation of the network though purchase and placement of e-bikes and charging stations in the whole cbc area; training the operators for e-bike maintenance and small repairs; promotional campaign; information and publicity campaign, organization of promotional events; participation at tourism fairs; project management.

The main result of the project will be a created and well-promoted, recognizable network of e-bicycles in 32 towns in the cbc area.

titleEn: Combined Efforts in Support to Disadvantaged People on the Labour Market in the Cross-Border Area
summaryEn:
The project “Combined Efforts in Support to Disadvantaged People on the Labour Market in the Cross-Border Area” implements the overall strategic objective of the programme and aims to assist the integration of disadvantaged people on the labour market in the CB area, development of joint strategies and research of best practices for employment and capacity building for this specific vulnerable group.
We shall analyze the labour market situation of disadvantaged people, research the problems discouraging them to enter the labour market, explore the specific capabilities for employment and the obstacles to CB mobility. As a part of this project, a consultancy center shall be created and a manual on innovative labour practices, methods and guidelines shall be prepared to demonstrate to disadvantaged people approaches for access to the labour market in the CB area and to assist them actively seeking employment by increasing the labour mobility. A web portal shall be developed where the interested parties will be able to share the advantages and opportunities for employment, to share joint strategies, measures and best practices for improvement, including improvement of employability. LB of the project is Association “Roma Bark” partnered by the Municipality of Berkovitsa and the Romanian partner Association for Regional Development and Partnership. The project corresponds to the specific objective of PA4, and will be implemented within 18 months. The overall budget of the project is EUR 181 827,05.

titleEn: Integrated Culinary Arts and Restaurant Sector Employment Solutions for a Skilled and Inclusive Romania-Bulgaria Cross Border Region
summaryEn:
ICARUS seeks to facilitate labor mobility in the restaurant/culinary business in the RO-BG cross border (CB) area through joint skill-building and employment mobility support services. It aims at creating preconditions for CB labor integration by developing a comprehensive support scheme based on the following key activities and tools: VET training programs fine-tuned to the needs of CB business
Methods and tests for assessing potential employees’ personal skill, Pilot vocational training with CB mobility for 120 persons, Pilot assessment of the personal skills of 150 persons, Continuous VET and lifelong learning pathways, A sustainable RO-BG Cross Border Center for the Facilitation of Labor Mobility in the Culinary and Restaurant Business - a support structure linking education providers, job seekers and business, and providing possibilities for personalized advisory services and counseling for mobile workers and CB employers. These activities should result in improved transferability of employees’ professional and personal skills to business conditions at the other side of the border and should alleviate the uncertainties (for both employees and employers) about the consequences of CB employment. The overall project impact should be to increase labor force preparedness for employment mobility and raise the attractiveness of CB employment among employers and the labor force. The project budget is 437 497 euro distributed among 2 BG partners and a RO VET center.

titleEn: Regional Network for Social Cohesion
summaryEn:
The main problem addressed is insufficient level of cross-border and public-private cooperation in social field on all levels, which is inadequate in a difficult social situation in border regions and in the context of ongoing social reforms in both countries with common (European) targets.

>Overall objective: through cross-border consolidation of resources, capacity building and public-private partnership to achieve provision of more effective social services for people at risk of poverty or social exclusion in Bg-Ro border area. 

The proposed budget is 353 826.71 euro.

Project activities include: Mapping of social resources in border area; Comparative research of social systems; Creation of a Virtual Community of Practice (CoP); International experts’ meeting; 10 thematic exchange of experience forums; 10 joint training sessions; 6 exchange visits; Closing conference; Publications; Publicity measures and project management.

The general result will be contribution to result indicator “level of co-ordination of the public institutions in the eligible area” (in social field), more concretely: A joint evaluation of current situation and needs assessment implemented; A virtual CoP created for networking; A data-base about social legislation, policy, social providers created; 300 social experts enhanced their qualification; 12 social organizations shared practical experience; A Bg-Ro cross-border social network created.

Project incorporated one cross-border mechanism for enhancing level of cooperation of the public institutions.

titleEn: Risk Management for Large Scale Infrastructures in the Romanian Bulgarian cross border area
summaryEn:
The pre-condition of a sound risk management activity is the due and comprehensive understanding of the existing vulnerabilities, hazards and potential calculated risks. It is one of the communist era heritages - both in Bulgaria and Romania- that important Large Scale Infrastructure/ LSI objectives were treated in maximum of secrecy, without any consideration of social acceptance or even understanding by the involved population. The identified problem is the incremental risk factor due to the lack of knowledge and understanding of the context and functioning of LSI in the RO BG cross border area. LSI was localized only taking in account technical and economic reasons. Dams and power plants, bridges, nuclear industry units, chemical plants, military units, waste treatment plants are LSI which generated huge anthropic hazard sources which are included eventually in emergency management plans, but for sure public awareness is missing. “Lost opportunity risk” is defined as the risk generated by the lack of ability of a region to take development advantage of a LSI located there. This is a specific anthropic risk conducting to social/economic catastrophes such as depopulation, extreme poverty etc. The project is contributing to make the ROBG 2014+ program area safer by addressing specific atrophic hazards and possible mitigation. The addressed project area is ranked as the less developed EU region but an area in which important strategic objectives are located. On the Romanian side we have Cernavoda, Danube Harbors, Iron gate, Navigation channel, ferry stations, ELI NP. On the Bulgarian side we have Kozlodui, Belene, Ruse, harbors, navigation channel and ferryboat stations. The population living in the impact area of the targeted LSI is estimated to be over 5,000,000 (3.16 million (66%) in Romania 1.61 million (34%) in Bulgaria). The following map is illustrating some of the significant existing and emerging region relevant LSIs. Our project aims at contributing to increase the local public awareness regarding LSI through training and communication. These activities will be targeted to LSI managements, NGOs, local and central governments. The overall cost incurred by the proposed actions is about EUR 1.100.000. The proposed actions are proposing better explanation to the targeted social-economic segments of how LSI are working, which are the benefits, which are the assumed hazards, how risks are configured and mitigated.
After a sound and comprehensive inventory of the ranked LSI in the program area LSI specific management and communication plans will be developed and validated by the project steering group. This project steering group will include the major actors/ stakeholders in charge with risk management, the local authorities and the civil society organizations. Actions include training sessions, simulations, site visits and workshops. The targeted output indicator is: “Population benefiting from actions of risk management”, proposed value for 2023: 2.500.000. The assumed contribution of the project could be the increase of the number of population informed regarding the LSI to 100,000. This would be realized by a proper info/communication activity, using direct channels and communicators. The result indicator of the “satisfaction rate of the population” will be for sure increased because informed population will be able to answer the Programme proposed survey!

titleEn: “Danube - I can hear you and I will not forget you, I can see you and I will remember you, I can recreate you and I can understand you”
summaryEn:
The difference in policies in the fields of culture and natural heritage on each side of the border of Bulgaria and Romania are further increasing the difficulty of promoting cross-border cooperation and joint development. These barriers establish a negative mindset amongst the local communities. Furthermore, there is a lack of information of the potential of cultural and natural heritage of the regions. Another problem is the lack of stable contacts between cultural “actors”, in a region which is so “close” not only in distance, but also in culture, traditions and cultural heritage
The objective of present proposal is to improve the sustainable use of natural heritage and resources and cultural heritage in cross-border region – Districts Vratsa and Ruse, Bulgaria and District Olt, Romania, and to increase the number of tourist’s overnights. The budget of the action is: 250 198.80 Euro. Main activities: Information campaign for project promotion and raising public awareness; Educational programs and trainings „Train the trainer“; Summer workshops for students and youth; Festival for ancient cultures and traditional crafts; Assembly “Crafts – yesterday, today and tomorrow”; International conferencesResults of the action: Improved cross-border cultural cooperation; Increased awareness of the cultural heritage; Promoted cultural events and initiatives of the CBC regions; Increase of number of visits to sites of cultural and natural heritage and attraction.

titleEn: Modernization of the hospitals in Zimnicea and Svishtov
summaryEn:
Low social cohesion represents one of the main challenges within the cross border area. Some of the causes generating this challenges are: Unsustainable and inaccessible public healthcare system, Low health care availability: funding and medical personnel problems, Many smaller cities without proper health care establishments making the population seek quality health services in bigger cities. The project will address the above causes, in order to contribute to developing sustainable and accessible public health care in Zimnicea City and Svishtov Municipality. Project aim: To improve the efficiency of health services and the collaboration between health care providers at the level of communities from Zimnicea and SvishtovSpecific objectives: To modernize the health services provided by the hospitals from Zimnicea and Svishtov, To develop the cross-border cooperation within health field between Zimnicea and SvishtovExpected results: 2 hospitals modernized (Zimnicea and Svishtov), 2 exchanges of experience between hospitals employees. Total budget: 1.494.719,43 Euro. Main activities: Activity 1 Project Preparation consists of identifying the project partners and creating the partnership. Activity 2 Project management will ensure the project implementation, in line with the project objectives and results, in accordance with the rules and provision stated in the financing contract. It will consist of coordination of the project implementation and team. Activity 3 Information and publicity will ensure the project visibility and promotion, through on-line, printing, in accordance with the Programme Visual Identity Manual rules. All the information regarding the project (activities, objectives, results, financing, etc.) will be posted on the partners web sites. In order to enforce the promotion of the project and to ensure large audience being informed about the project will be organized 2 conferences (60 participants/conference) during the project implementation period (project launching conference – year 1 in Romania, 1 final conference during year 2 in Romania). The objective of the project launching conference is to present the project activities, objectives, results, financing package, in accordance with the rules stated in the Visual Identity Manual of the Programme. There will be invited reprezentatives of the Managing Authority, public Romanian and Bulgarian authorities relevant for the project objectives, mass-media and other bodies/institutions. There will be organized 2 local conferences in Bulgaria (30 participants/conference) during the project implementation period (project launching conference, 1 final conference during year 2). The objective of the project launching conference is to present the project activities, objectives, results, financing package, in accordance with the rules stated in the Visual Identity Manual of the Programme. Activity 4 Modernization of the hospital in Zimnicea will consist of modernization of hospital from Zimnicea, based on hospital needs, meaning purchasing equipment. The equipment will help increasing the relative share of citizens with access to modern treatment, and for the provision of complex and high-quality diagnostics where patients will not have to visit the district centres to this end. The equipment will ensure capacity for professional and quality treatment of different in type and complexity diseases through an early and timely diagnostics. Activity 5 Modernization of the hospital in Svishtov will consist of modernization of hospital from Svishtov, based on hospital needs, meaning purchasing equipment according to the table below. The equipment will help increasing the relative share of citizens with access to modern treatment, and for the provision of complex and high-quality diagnostics where patients will not have to visit the district centres to this end. Activity 6 Exchange of experience and best practices will consist of: One exchange of experience for 3 days in Zimnicea city for 20 employees from Zimnicea hospital and 20 from Svishtov hospital, One exchange of experience for 3 days in Svishtov city for 20 employees from Zimnicea hospital and 20 from Svishtov hospitalFulfillment of the project expected results will generate on one hand to improving the health care services and on the other hand to strengthening cooperation capacity through: developing health care infrastructure
Exchange of experience between hospitals employees. The cooperation between the 2 beneficiaries will be strengthen through the project activities. The exchange of experience activity will focus on cross border healthcare cooperation for a better provision of healthcare, in terms of efficiency, adaptability with a comparable quality. Information added on 2020-05-11, regarding the mitigation of the effects of COVID-19 (the corona virus pandemic that started in 2019) (English language only): In the current context of the pandemic caused by the Covid-19 coronavirus, in Teleorman County, the Caritas Rosiorii de Vede Municipal Hospital has been designated as a support hospital for the treatment of patients infected with the virus. As it does not have all the necessary equipment for a large influx of critically ill patients, Zimnicea City Hospital lent Caritas Hospital 2 injectomates, 3 vital functions monitors and 1 general anesthesia device, equipment purchased through the project ROBG-174 "Your health matters! - Modernization of hospitals in Zimnicea and Svishtov”. The aforementioned equipment will be entrusted to Caritas Hospital in Roșiorii de Vede Municipality, Teleorman county, until the treatment of the patients infected with Covid-19 continues.

titleEn: Career Paths to Youth  Labor Mobility
summaryEn:
The project tackles the high level of unemployment among people with higher education as a common challenge in the CBC area. Our area survey estimates that only 57% of the university graduates find jobs home but 95% of them have never searched for a job across the Danube due to barriers as: language, unawareness on employment opportunities, not labor market-oriented education. Since these are common territorial challenges, the best way to respond is to approach them on a CBC level.

Capitalizing the results of the Erasmus plus students’ exchange programs of the participating universities and the achievements of the previous project MIS ETC Code 219: Region Wide Education, the project enables the five beneficiaries from the problematic areas to tackle the issues.

In line with Europe 2020, the project enables horizontal integration and CBC cooperation b/n them and employment related institutions and lowers the identified CBC barriers via the provision of 8 employment initiatives. The latter include: mobile application ‘ Cool to be mobile’, joint labor-market oriented educational scheme, joint internet-based tools and job fairs on employment.

To impact the whole CBC region, the project invests in web-based provision of comprehensive and official information on social security, employment and tax legislation as well as virtual Entrepreneurship trainings. In this area, it capitalizes the results of MIS ETC Code 629 project INNOBRIDGE.

‘Career Paths to Youth Labor Mobility’ provides access of 5910 people to 8 joint youth employment initiatives.

titleEn: Coordinating and supporting the modernization of the public health services in Dolj - Vratsa
summaryEn:
DJ&VR region is affected by descendant demography, while healthcare, as major contributor to life quality & expectancy, is one of the pillars of cross-border community. On both sides, these services are affected by restrictive public funding, lack of performance & efficiency, some treatments being unavailable within area.

While EU legislative framework is requiring effective cross-border medical assistance, the health players lack coordination at all levels.

The project aims to increase the level of coordination among VR&DJ health players, and the efficiency of this public sector, with a total budget of 1,499,999.95 Euro (eligible), through: assessment of the health sectors in DJ&VR, in view of developing complementarity; increasing the efficiency of the 2 medical providers by modernization in a cooperation context; study case on access to medical care of cardiovascular surgery at CBC level; professionals networking & awareness & information addressed to population, professionals & other players.

The cooperation will be performed on three levels:

regulatory & institutional: joint work & common analyses on systems from both sides, in context of complementarity & coherence;

enhancing the efficiency of the medical services in CBC context: increasing the level of networking among professionals & ensuring performant & quality treatment conditions provided by B3 & Ivan Rislki Hospital, Kozloduy;

Information & awareness for institutions, professionals & prospective patients.

Information added on 2020-05-11, regarding the mitigation of the effects of COVID-19 (the corona virus pandemic that started in 2019) (English language only): Project ROBG-160 made possible the establishment of the Interventional Cardiology and Cardiovascular Surgery Clinic within the Clinical Emergency County Hospital Craiova, ensuring equipment and human resources at most modern EU and international standards. 

Given the current situation generated by the spread of Covid-19, starting March 27, 2020, the Interventional Cardiology Clinic within the emergency county hospital in Craiova, which was financed under the Interreg V-A Romania-Bulgaria Programme, has become a triage and testing center for patients suspected of Covid-19.

titleEn: Cross-border Sustainable Employment Mix-Centres in the fields of information technologies, tourism and agriculture
summaryEn:
One of the most urging issues within the entire cross-border region is the current employment situation showing that the supply and the demand of work is unbalanced as a result of a general climate unfavourable to business-related initiatives. Project main objective is to improve the cross-border labour market conditions towards an integrated market with better employment rates. 

The project is aiming to improve the joint labour market in three key fields such as ICT, tourism and agriculture within the entire CB region. Within a total budget of 410 168.12 euro it will provide the opportunity to the CB population to have access to specialized SEM-Centres and a training platform which will increase the labour mobility. The project also aims at improving job opportunities in the cross-border area by exchange of information and experiences, provision of joint trainings and job fairs helping employers and workers to deal with specific problems of the area, incl. exchange of business and legal information. The market and legal analysis of the entire region, as well as the Joint Guides on legal and tax, and employment issues will increase the knowledge of the population and will give them the opportunity for a better inclusion in the labour market. 

Project’s implementation will significantly increase the number of participants in joint local employment initiatives and joint trainings which is among the Programme output indicators.

titleEn: Ancient roman cultural heritage interactive visualization environment for the cross border area between Bulgaria and Romania
summaryEn:
The objective of the project is the preservation and the popularisation of historically and culturally significant sites from the lower part of the Roman Limes, a UNESCO World Heritage site candidate. This specific problem area was selected due to many preserved, but fairly unknown sites along the lower part of the Danube river and on the border area between Bulgaria and Romania. In order to complete this objective we have planned to purchase and use modern aerial and ground image capturing devices, green technologies and attractive visualisation systems. 

The first of the project activities involves categorisation and selection of the roman sites and objects. After analysing all possibilities we will make a list of the most important and significant targets and we will collect all available documents, photographs, videos, historical details, etc. about them. Additional information will be obtained by on-site ground and aerial images and video clips. All data will then be prepared, processed and popularized using a specially designed for the purpose web-based platform and applications for mobile devices. The aerial and ground images will be used for creation of detailed 3D models of the sites, which will later be printed using 3D printers and will be presented to the mass public in museum exhibitions by the partners in the project (Annex 15). 

The project budget (601 962.00 €) will be used for equipment purchases, the development of the content platforms and the on-site shots.

titleEn: Development of common database and legal framework for ships inspections for the common Bulgarian-Romanian stretch of the Danube river with interface to the national River Information Service (RIS)
summaryEn:
Despite the professional cooperation between Romanian naval authority (R.N.A) and Executive Agency “Maritime Administration” (EAMA) it is indicated urgent need of improvement of their communication aiming at more efficient work and better control and monitoring.
