The management of protected areas is of crucial importance for preservation of habitats and species; planning economic activities and investments in sustainable way, so the local population could benefit instead of suffering barriers due to closeness to protected area. The analysis of implemented activities and measures of the integrated plan for ecological corridor Ruse-Giurgiu, developed under project MIS-ETC662; Management plan for Nature Park Rusenski Lom, GIS and evaluation of ecosystem services aim to provide alternatives before local population to the activities limited by the protected area status.

By implementation of activities envisaged on the project we implement the guidelines of the Framework water policy; biodiversity protection (Habitat and Birds Directive); transfer of knowledge; exchange of good practice; networking and development of innovations in protection/preservation of eco systems.

The project contributes to Priority axis: A green region.
The overall objective is contribution to improve the sustainable use of natural heritage and resources and cultural heritage.
The specific objective of the project is planning management on the field of environment and landscape for Nature Park Rusenski Lom and Comana via undate of Integrated plan for ecological corridor Comana-Lomovete; update of the management plan of Nature Park Rusenski Lom; GIS for Nature Park Rusenski Lom and Nature Park Comana; evaluation of ecosystem services for Nature Park Rusenski Lom and Nature Park Comana.

The expected results refer to updated management tools for 4 Natura 2000 sites.

The implementation of envisaged activities contributes to Programme indicator I10- Number of common strategies, policies or management plans for valorising (including raising awareness) the cultural and natural herritage throgh its restoration and promotion for sustainable economic uses. It will provide 1 updated Integrated plan for ecological corridor Comana-Lomovete;1 updated management plan for Nature Park Rusenski Lom; digitalized data in GIS for each territory; elaborated 2 evaluations for ecosystem services for Nature park Rusenski Lom and Nature park Comana. 

As defined in the Proposal for the joint management plan for the cross-border corridor between Comana and Lomovete, it is defined as a ‘geographical space containing a combination of ecosystems characterized by relief forms, plantation cover, human culture and history, determined on social, managerial and scientific basis, which are of importance for the protection of biodiversity and landscape’. The cross-border ecological corridor Comana and Lomovete is sufficiently large to secure the preservation of habitats and valuable species. On the other hand, the corridor is sufficiently small, because it is considered a ‘home’ by local population. The cross-border ecological corridor does not necessarily coincide with administrative boundaries and is expanded beyond these, which is of great importance for its functioning. It includes a mosaic of habitats, representatives of important bio-geographical regions, plus the tradition of human intervention. Has a tremendous importance for the protection of biological diversity. Creates opportunities for research and demonstration of approaches towards sustainable development at the regional level. It has appropriate size in order to secure the three main functions–conservation, development, logistic support. It maintains those functions through appropriate zoning.

The evaluation of eco system services aims at elaboration of sustainable links between tourism development and economic activities in protected territories and maintaining the aesthetics and biodiversity’s value, providing the ecosystems in the target protected area. In this sense, the envisaged activities are directly linked to valorization of natural heritage.

By this approach, illustration of economic benefits of clean environment is achieved by providing a frame for development of new sustainable economic activities.

The budget for Directorate of Nature Park Rusenski Lom is 268603 euro.
The budget for Association Ecologic Center Green Area Giurgiu is 200249 euro.
The total envisaged budget is 468852 euro.

titleEn: Preparation of a project for fostering the sustainable use of cultural heritage in the vicinity of spas and wellness centres in the Danube Region
Innovation for Dementia in the Danube Region
summaryEn:
As a consequence of demographic change, dementia is a growing societal challenge in the Danube region. However, the quality of dementia care lags behind European standards in terms of knowledge, skills and cooperation of healthcare professionals, availability of specific services, and use of assistive technology. The Danube region also suffers from emigration of healthcare workers. The main objective of INDEED is to improve dementia care in the Danube region and contribute to the implementation of national dementia strategies with the scope of enhancing the quality of life of people with dementia and their carers. In a collaborative effort of partners from 10 countries INDEED creates an information and skill-building intervention for institutions involved in dementia care and their members or employees, including health and social services, professional associations, governmental authorities, public administrations and private enterprises. The intervention comprises 3 modules: an interdisciplinary training (CAMPUS), a networking tool (CONNECT), and a business consulting service (COACH). 
INDEED will enhance the competences of multiple professions that engage in dementia care, enhance their collaboration and coordination, improve the quality and delivery of services, and foster the development of innovative care facilities and business models. The intervention will be delivered in blended-learning format and will be evaluated in pilot actions in four countries. It will be disseminated to the above mentioned target groups including health and social policy makers. INDEED is innovative since it simultaneously addresses three major unmet needs in dementia care, delivers coherent information and training for all relevant professional groups, and combines traditional learning formats with web-based education technology. INDEED also pioneers by promoting cross-border knowledge transfer and exchange of best practices in healthcare.

titleEn: Promoting cross-border tourism by tailor-made ICT solutions
summaryEn:
BorderPass addresses Priority 3 of the EUSDR, Culture & tourism. From the focus areas pre-defined by the Danube Seed Money Facility, the project addresses Nr.2, i.e. to "Develop applications and other innovative tools for tourists that use information and communication technologies (ICT) promoting and clearly illustrating the natural and cultural heritage of the Danube region".

The project addresses border regions across the Danube macro-region and aims to promote cross-border tourism by tailor-made ICT solutions.  We aim to develop a platform, which provides the users with information on both sides of a border region, thus presenting an integrated touristic offer and a more diverse destination for visitors. The BorderPass platform will contain the following features:
- single point of access to up-to-date information on cultural and natural heritage sights, accommodations, services, events in the border region,
- information segmented and structured along different “user profiles” (e.g. visitors with a family, cultural tourists, eco-tourists, etc.),
- a “chatbot”, providing instant feedback to the visitors in various languages,
- a community platform for information exchange among users.

The BorderPass platform shall facilitate an effective information flow and help overcome barriers to low accessibility, deficient advertising, and language differences. It will give the necessary incentives to the visitors to pass the border and explore more of the cultural and natural heritage of the Danube macroregion. The project will also fully take into consideration environmental aspects, thus partly contributing to P6 (Biodiversity, landscapes, quality of air and soils) of the EUSDR as well.

titleEn: Boost potential of Young Innovators to pioneer change in energy efficiency inside Danube Macro-region
summaryEn:
Danube Energy+ tackles the need for change in regional ecosystems to support Young Innovators in transforming their disruptive ideas into ventures. Project´s general objective is to create an enabling environment, which will support Young innovators to pioneer a change in the energy efficiency area by setting up highly innovative startups in the Danube macro-region.

Danube Energy+ ecosystem Package as an innovative learning system for key regional ecosystem actors will be developed by using learning interaction among project partners and inclusive design process involving regional public administrations, universities, SMEs and business supporting actors. It is uniquely composed of two main elements – (1) best practices, models and experience in identification and motivation of individual Young Innovators in regional ecosystems and their connection to ecosystem actors, and (2) developed Danube Energy+ Tool as a pre-acceleration learning scheme for Young Innovators boosting their competences to start successful ventures.

The learning system will be piloted in 9 countries involving 90 key regional ecosystem actors and 90 Young innovators enabling improvement of regional ecosystem actors´ knowledge.
To ensure regional and transregional level sustainability and transferability, regional Danube Energy+ Hubs will be created in close cooperation of regional public administrations and Regional Alliance members based on regional Action Plans and Transregional Hubs´ Strategy including the transferability plan to other regions.

9 project partners and 7 associated strategic partners as key strategic cooperating bodies with regional public administrations will join Danube Energy+ project to create a unique partnership based around core expertises needed: work with Young innovators in regional ecosystems; pre-acceleration programmes development and running; cooperation with regional stakeholders, Hubs creation and operations and regional policy sustainability and support.

titleEn: Efficient and sustainable Danube navigation based on forward looking competences – Innovative SKILLS
summaryEn:
Education and training are the backbone of the transport sector: they attract youngsters to the profession, educate and train them to achieve the knowledge,skills and proficiency required to be able to execute their future job in a safe, secure and sustainable way and also offer lifelong learning programmes to improve competences and skills of current employees or inactive workforce and ultimate employability opportunities thereof. Addressing the major barrier remaining in the Danube riparian countries after adoption of a common European legal framework governing skills and qualifications in IWT sector, Innovative SKILLS shall attempt to solve the shortage of qualified personnel, one of EUSDR Priority Area 1a targets, by aligning skills and competences with current and future labour market requirements and promote entrepreneurship for Danube navigation businesses among youth and adults.A holistic approach is adopted towards inland navigation (IWT) as part of a smart integrated multimodal transport system in the project’s attempt to offer solutions ensuring that IWT becomes a more attractive sector especially for youth in order to rejuvenate the IWT staff in high proportion aged 50+.

Entrepreneurial and digital skills will be developed to match latest innovations and digital technologies,based on appropriate education and training and lifelong learning programmes responding to tomorrow’s needs of the transport labour market, addressing PA 1a Topic 2 and aiming at raising the operational efficiency of vessels by improving competences of IWT staff and thus enhancingcompetitiveness of the sector. In addition, Topic 3 Reduction of administrative barriers in Danube navigation is tackled through logistics courses including border control procedures to be mastered by IWT staff and intended to reduce waiting times at border crossings as well as the duration of controls, beneficial for the inland waterway industry and contributing to the achievement of EUSDR PA1a targets.

titleEn: Analysis of the shallow geothermal energy exploitation potential and its' use in heating of rural and semirural area
summaryEn:
Danube countries are increasingly dependent on the import of primary energy sources - mainly gas and oil. Only a few countries of the Danube region have an important share of their energy generation from the use of renewable sources. In most of the regions shallow geothermal is exploited not nearly in its full potential. On the other hand, these regions usually have a lot of potential and possibilities in using the shallow geothermal energy for different purposes such as electricity production, district heating and especially in rural areas for agricultural purposes. Furthermore, local municipalities which have developed their energy action plans (EAP) usually overlook the benefits their region could have from geothermal energy exploitation (both deep and shallow) and do not include it the EAPs. 
The main objective of this project is to analyze the shallow geothermal potential for heating in the partner rural and semirural regions, raise awareness of the local government in potentials and possibilities of using shallow geothermal energy in their regions as well as to include scientific institutions and companies providing innovations in the field of shallow geothermal energy in the development of innovative geothermal solutions. Different levels of shallow geothermal energy exploitations and use in different regions will ensure that the regions with the same potential will learn and transfer this knowledge between themselves. Through better planning of exploitation of geothermal energy PP regions will bring themselves closer to satisfying EU requirements in enhancement of the energy production from RES and lowering of the emission of greenhouse gases. The project will contribute to the The Danube Region Strategy in Priority Area 2 Sustainable energy, point 2 More efficient use of RES -  contributing to the goals of the Energy Union, diversification of supply, reducing gas dependency and increasing the availability of renewable resources for domestic use.

titleEn: Fostering enhanced ecotourism planning along the Eurovelo cycle route network in the Danube region
summaryEn:
EcoVeloTour facilitates the development of sustainable tourism in the Danube region along EuroVelo routes via enhanced, conscious and ecologically sound framework of tourism destination management and extending cyclist tourism, unfolding neighbouring regions beyond the EuroVelo route. The regions will capitalize on cultural and natural heritage, through the integration of the ecosystem service framework into ecotourism planning, that enable the attentive maintenance of high ecosystem provisions that contribute to the well-being of the region including ecotourism stakeholders in the long run. The framework will be strongly support by sustainable mobility guidelines, that is key element in comprehensive ecotourism planning, esp. in the case of cyclist ecotourism. Moreover, a comprehensive market research will help Danube region wide to assess better the potentials and ways forward in the ecotourism development.

Regional ecotourism strategies will be elaborated based on the developed framework and good practices, studies on ecotourism, green mobility, knowledge exchange, potential ecosystem service mapping of pilot areas, intensive key actors’ cooperation, stakeholder analysis and participation, learning interactions (including e-learning) at regional and transnational level. The implementation of the strategies starts during the project lifetime including small-scale investments too. The bottom-up approach, collected experience from local level will result in a policy recommendation to ensure the capitalization of project results at policy-maker level.

Outputs will be: (i) transnational tools for ecotourism development and management: enhanced framework for ecotourism development and mobility planning guidelines, transnational market research, policy recommendation, ecotourism mobile app., e-learning platform; (ii) pilot regional ecotourism strategies; (iii) transnational learning interactions.

titleEn: Rediscover, expose and exploit the concealed Jewish heritage of the Danube Region
summaryEn:
CEE was home to flourishing Jewish communities before WWII. By capitalizing on this legacy, we can create value in social cohesion, tourism potential and cultural abundance. Mid-sized cities, with limited built heritage, would generally be surmounted by major attractions and well-known heritage centres on the tourism market. The challenge is to find ways to explore and build on both tangible and intangible elements, in order to create competitive cultural products, with potential to grow, and join into cross-country networks. 

Main objective is to build on currently undiscovered potential in the Jewish cultural heritage of cities, and develop contemporary tourism solutions, while smartly arranging visibility, accessibility and sustainability. A key element of the approach is intangible heritage considered as a valid factor to create awareness and interest. These elements (music & literature, religion & festivals, traditions & lifestyle, cuisine & local recipes, history & contribution to the development of the local community, oral history, photo collections, legacy of famous local born Jewish personalities) are organised into creative attractions, combined with visible synagogues, cemeteries, memorial sites and buildings.


Main result is the rediscovery of locally available Jewish heritage, turned into jointly presented, synergic tourism assets, through a co-creative, community sourced process. Positive effects include improved awareness among younger generations, a critical mass of destination potential to achieve international visibility, and strengthening the visitor economy of targeted cities.

The involvement of locations with different historic economic background also enables the creation of solutions applicable for various other contexts, supporting transferability. Key outputs, like Joint Visibility Strategy, or Community–sourced Jewish Cultural Heritage Valorisation Handbook help to replicate the initiative in further cities of the Danube Region.

titleEn: Following Roman Footsteps - Strengthening and Expansion of the Roman Emperors Danube Route
summaryEn:
The European Union Strategy for the Danube Region (EUSDR) acknowledges that due to “common history and tradition, culture and arts reflecting the diverse communities of the Danube Region (DR), as well as its outstanding natural heritage, the Region has attractive assets. A common and sustainable approach to improving and publicising these opportunities should make the Danube Region a European and world brand”.
 
The Roman Emperors Danube Route currently extends through four countries of the Middle and Lower Danube Region – Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria and Romania – encompassing 20 archaeological sites. It is a network of individual sub-destinations – archaeological sites, locations, places and buildings containing non-material and material heritage that are from the same period of history, belonging to the same Roman cultural heritage and having mutual geographic characteristics. Each sub-destination and the Route as a whole can be perceived as a unique tourism destination, in the sense of its tourism potential and competitiveness. However, however for the cultural route to be successful it is necessary to strengthen it as a joint tourism product.
 
The project focuses on contributing to the PA3 - to promote culture, tourism and people to people contacts of the EUSDR, specifically its target 3 - develop new and support existing Cultural Routes relevant in the DR as it will have a significant impact on further expanding the Route to other countries of the region: Hungary, Austria and Germany, while positioning it on the market as a tourism destination. Another important impact of this project is the consolidation of the Route’s network while insisting on sharing experience for improving the management model and elaboration of joint policy documents. The touristic offer will thus be enhanced via putting into perspective joint and unique European heritage of the Roman period for the benefit of visitors experience and satisfaction.

titleEn: Transnational Cooperation in Higher Education in the Danube Region
summaryEn:
The SMF project proposal is focused on the development of a complex strategic transnational project aimed at acting as a policy driver in higher education for a better integration of professional qualifications. The project proposal aims to create a relevant consortium consisting of higher education institutions, regulatory bodies and umbrella-type organisations. The consortium will tackle the common challenges and needs deriving from both tertiary educational system and labour market in logistics field. The outputs of the SMF project will support PA7 coordinators to strenghten their capacity in implementing and communicating the EUSDR in order to achieve their own targets (increasing the annual output of co-publications in the region by 15% by 2020 and enhancing regional research and education co-operation to reach 20% of academic mobility within the region by 2020). The SMF project will deliver 3 pre-defined outputs as follows:

1. Report on  the state of play in higher education – labour market in logistic field consisting in description of the current situation including bridging the gaps opportunities related to professional qualifications and job positions in Danube Region. The target group will consist from academic comunity and stakeholders from the logistic field in terms of required competences and knowledge of the graduates in order to better fit to the job positions on logistic labour market.

2. Main project work plan consisting of consortium partnership agreement, structure of the work packages, list of planned activities and deliverables, responsibilities of the partners and breakdown budget of the main project.

3. Report on funding possibilities consisting of the identification of appropriate funding programmes in 2019 as well as a road map for further actions after the SMF project is finalised. The road map will establish all the necessary steps for submitting in 2019 the proposal for the main project.

titleEn: Enhance skills and competences to boost material innovations and eco innovations in automotive industry
summaryEn:
Automotive industry became the most important economic engine of many Danube Region (DR) countries, whose problem is that however they are a manufacturing power, they experience hardship to move towards R&D; and environmentally responsible industry.

The aim of the main project is to close the knowledge gap, caused by shortage of highly skilled and competent professionals in new materials R&D; and reuse of hardly recyclable material, within the automotive industry by implement elements of dual education and joint research centers.

The result of the project will be improved education curricula and research policies particularly focused on implementation of dual education, and increased competences in research management and cooperation of companies, academia, policy makers in automotive industry and beyond.

The project aims to support the PA7 of EUSDR, and targets the topic for SMF: “Higher education institutions (HEIs), industry and government (public) institutions stimulating the automotive industry in the Danube region in order to meeting the industry’s requirement of skilled manpower - running employability - skill enhancement programs and to set - up training centers/labs - improving the competitiveness of industry - increasing the relevance and innovativeness of research in HEIs - knowledge transfer”

The main project will contribute and find synergies with other projects or initiatives supporting in PA7, PA8, PA9 aiming to close the knowledge gap. Project partially contributes to PA2 target to better interconnect regions by joint activities by focusing on research of material technologies to make the vehicles less energy demanding. The project will capitalize the findings of studies developed by PACs and DTP projects.

titleEn: Digitally Skilled Women Entrepreneurs
summaryEn:
The digital transformation is structurally changing the entrepreneurship and the nature of work. There are concerns that these changes may affect employment conditions, levels and income distribution. Alongside investment in technology, there is a need of investment in human skills and knowledge, to be ready for the future. The need for new multidisciplinary digital skills is exploding. There is a specific need to improve the understanding of skills requirements for new technologies, promote development of digital skills and stimulate partnerships for skills within the framework of the New Skills Agenda for Europe.
According to “Socio-economic Assessment of the Danube Region: State of the Region, Challenges and Strategy Development” /Nov.2015/ the supply and demand in educational system in the Danube region are not coordinated. This slows down entrepreneurship in the Danube Region (DR).
WE.DIGITAL comes as a response to improve the entrepreneurship education in order to enhance the competitiveness of women entrepreneurship through further development of the lifelong entrepreneurial learning system based on identified set of strategic goals in line with Human Capital Dimension of the SBA for Europe. It will be focused on preparation of a complex strategic project contributing to PA 8 of EUSDR in relation with development of transnational innovative learning measures and tools to support acquiring of digital knowledge and skills of women entrepreneurs (WE).
The main project activities will be focused on innovative and practical solutions for strengthening female entrepreneurial skills in the digital age through increasing digital knowledge, networking, exchange of experience between business and academia, mentoring, organization of tailored events and setting of innovative tools for fostering women’s entrepreneurial skills.

titleEn: Harmonization of Green and Grey Infrastructure in Danube Region
summaryEn: The HARMON project proposal for the seed money facility is addressing the EUSDR's Priority Area 6: Biodiversity & Landscapes, the topic of Fostering Ecological Connectivity within Danube Region. The development of Transport Infrastructure when intersects Green Infrastructure increases the level of fragmentation of natural ecosystems which is considered as being one of the biggest threat to biodiversity. The aim of the main project proposal will be to contribute to securing and fostering ecological connectivity by ensuring the ecological requirements/ sufficiency of areas of high biodiversity value while developing linear transportation infrastructures in the Danube Region. The project results will contribute to achieve the TEN-G (Trans-European Network for Green Infrastructure) goal and will bring side contributions to other EUSDR PAs, as follows:Priority 1b - Rail-Road-Air Mobility, Topic 1:  The project will contribute to environmental sustainability within transport services in rural areas.Priority 6 - Biodiversity & Landscapes, Topic 3: Supporting sustainability on development of transportation projects in rural areas - the project will focus on supporting ecological connectivity and natural evolution of biodiversity, address the eradication of Invasive Alien Species and promote the integration of grey infrastructure in the local character of the Danube Region landscape.Priority 7 – Knowledge Society, Topic 2, 3, 4:  The project will promote and support the training, research, capacity-building,  adapted  policy on interdisciplinary level involving different target groups as universities, research centers, NGOs, decision makers, authorities and sectoral stakeholders increasing both the professionals’ capacity and job opportunities in combination of ecology and transportation.

titleEn: Empowering underdeveloped marginal communities’ trough Digital Transformation of SME’s
summaryEn:
For the economic development of the Danube Region (DR) it is decisive that SMEs have a strong competitive position & innovation performance (Regional Analysis-DR 2014, p.203)Considering digital revolution & disruptive technologies, SMEs in every industry of the participating regions are under intense pressure to rethink their business models, customer value propositions & operations. Smaller enterprises from less developed areas of the DR (rural area and small cities from East European countries of the DR) suffer more from the digital revolution than companies from more developed areas (normally strong urban communities).There is a strong need in the participating regions to develop solutions together and qualify SMEs from these underdeveloped areas to fully use digital opportunities.
The approach of this project aims to create the necessary framework to develop a new project that includes specific activities that respond to Priority 8 Competitiveness of Enterprises. Topic.

3.Strengthening of SMEs capacities to improve their competitiveness and profitability.
Available funding opp., like Horizon 2020 RURAL RENAISSANCE with open calls in 2018 – 2020, can offer the framework to develop innovative training measures for a better use of ICT tools and skills for entrepreneurs in less developed areas of the DR. The new project will forge a transnational alliance for the management of digital transformation with focus on rural area and small cities. The consortium will consist of leading digital innovation experts and scientists, well networked regional development actors and regional policy makers to assure a knowledge and different experiences transfer from the German and Austrian regions of the DR to less developed regions from DR. The new project will appeal at expertise from Business support organisations, research institutions, universities and NGO’s and will look for a close contact with relevant stakeholders such as Loc. and Reg. Auth., local SME’s etc.

titleEn: Establishment of diagnostic centers for orthostatic and musculoskeletal disorders in school-age children in Serbia and Bulgaria

summaryEn:
The project aims to offer an integrated solution to the growing prevalence of orthostatic and musculoskeletal disorders/ODN/to school-age children in the cross-border region. It envisages the creation of a sustainable cross-border platform for prevention and treatment of OODN through regular screening, modern diagnostics and extracurricular pograms to improve physical skills and educating habits for active, healthy living. 

Two modernly equipped centers for orthostatic and musculoskeletal diagnostics in the towns of Knyazevac and Vidin are planned, including repair and rehabilitation of building stock, furnishing and delivery of diagnostic equipment of the last generation. The centers will offer non-invasive, radiation-safe examinations for school-age children in the region. 
Within the framework of the project will be diagnostics of 2000 school-age children (two examinations per child) and children with established OOD will be subjected to targeted physiotherapy through corrective gymnastics lasting 720 hours, according to a methodology specially developed for the purposes of the project. 
The positive results of restorative therapy will be demonstrated during a general children’s competition in Vidin, in which 200 children will participate. 

In order to increase public attention to the dissemination and danger of OODN, a conference will be organised in Knyazevac. An analytical report with public policy recommendations for the sustainable improvement of the physical skills, well-being and quality of life of young people in the cross-border region will be presented at the same forum.

titleBg: Българо - сръбско Гурме Влак
summaryEn: Organization of 4 Gastro Tourism forums two in Serbia and two in Bulgaria which will provide a valuable platform to exchange experiences in Gastro tourism and how to successfully manage this growing tourism segment in the region covered by the program of cross-border cooperation; Establishment of Bulgarian-Serbian Gastro Club as business club, which members are organizations working in the field of tourism and gastronomy; Registration of International Certification Trademark for Serbian and Bulgarian gastronomic products/services implies international Certification Trademark will be obtained for gastronomic products/services well known as Leskovac grill in Serbia and Neolithic bakey products in Bulgaria; Equipping Culinary Arts teaching and demonstration kitchen facility in Higher business school in Leskovac and for Vocational school in Mezdra to create culinary teaching practice centre with conditions for organizing the training of students and professionals in the field of preparation of traditional gourmet products with the registered Trademark; Development and realization of Training seminar for culinary arts students in Serbia and Bulgaria for preparing traditional Bulgarian and Serbian food. The trainings will be conducted by experts and specialists in nutrition and preparation of typical dishes of the region; Development and realization of Training seminar for professional chefs in Bulgaria and Serbia where professional chefs will learn how prepare and cook a complete menu which consists of typical dishes of Serbian and Bulgarian cuisine in the tradition of genuine simplicity; Joint participation on Gastronomic Festival in Serbia in order to promote specific traditional gastronomic products envisaged for certification, and their preparation and the way of service; Joint participation on Fair in Bulgaria in order to promote specific traditional gastronomic products envisaged for certification, and where Gastro Club members will present traditional way of preparing gastro products from Bulgaria and Serbia; Bulgarian Serbian Menu of Traditional Cuisine where traditional gastro products of Bulgaria and Serbia will be presented.

titleEn: Young entrepreneurs of today - successful people of tomorrow
titleBg: Младите предприемачи днес - успешни хора на бъдещето
summaryEn: Opening information conferences in Peturch & Pirot; Equipment of an education hall in the local community center in Peturch and Pirot; Creation of a website of the project as well as Facebook page; Selection of participants for the training courses; Training courses in Peturch & Pirot conducted in three specific modules; Preparation of a bilingual guide - “Job finding and business plan preparation”; Presentations in High schools in the region or Peturch and Pirot; Closing conferences in Peturch.

titleEn: Forest Fire Fighters
titleBg: Пребори горските пожари
summaryEn:
FFF has 9 activities(A) in the following groups (G).
Administrative & Public Awareness Raising Events:
A1 Project Management relates to FFF administration by 7 experts from each partner with complementary functions; A8 Conduct School Visits - classes to improve fire prevention and awareness on volunteering; A9 Project Awareness Events add events for key stakeholders and press to share the FFF success story.
Actions to equate people and equipment capacity: A2 Recruitment of Volunteers in Kula to double the unit via a dedicated campaign; A3 Procurement of Equipment for each minicipality to deliver drones, all terrain vehicles with mounted fire fighting equipment and personal gear for volunteers; A4 Development of GIS System in MoB to match the available software in BG; 
Improved Joint Coordination Actions: A5 Preparation of Joint Action Plan in 3 languages as a mechanism for joint CB operational interventions. Conduct theoretical Training Courses (A6) and a Joint Pilot Field Training (A7) to test the Plan.

titleEn: Clean and Green Life
titleBg: Чист и зелен живот
summaryEn:
The project aims at removing the root causes for unregulated dumpsites and improving municipal waste management through:
- provision of modern equipment to increase waste collection capacity,
- exchange of know-how and implementation of EU best practices into a joint action plan for waste management in the Kula-Knjazevac region, round table discussions and public debates;
- awareness raising on all levels on the importance of individual and community contribution for protecting the environment in the Kula-Knjazevac region. My Green Home cross-border eco initiative will be initiated inviting all residents to participate in cleaning unregulated dumpsites and scattered waste. Special attention will be paid to young people through a joint school campaign to build an eco-mindset in the next generation.

titleEn: Moving Borders for Volunteering
titleBg: Преместване на границите за добровлочеството
summaryEn:
1.Research of situation and needs of social volunteering in border region of both countries.


2.Development of common methodology for social volunteering across border area.


3.Nomination of local organizations to become providers of volunteer services in local communities of cross border area.


4.Equipment of volunteer centres on both sides with basic tools.


5.TOT - Training for volunteer centers leaders.


6.Orientation and training of volunteers.


7.Testing period - practice of volunteers in social services/organizations.


8.Volunteer exchange visits (cross-border volunteering).


9.Closing forum for evaluation of results.


10.Web platform creation.


11. Publications for dissemination of project achievements .

titleEn: Virtual Enterprises
titleBg: Виртуални предприятия
summaryEn: Establishing of a shared workspace YES -- “Young Entrepreneurs Space”; Designing of a joint tri-lingual website; Development of Database of potential trainees; Selection of participants; Elaboration of Study and analysis on the potential of the Cross-border region to reduce youth migration; Elaboration of Local Policy Guide on Youth Enterpreneurship; Elaboration of "Virtual Enterprise" Software product; Establishment of virtual companies for self-employment; Joint workshop for P2P learning and exchange for the participants of the Virtual Enterprise after course; Elaboration of manual – necessary documents for establishing a company; Presentation for high-school students; Establishing of virtual companies (Employment).

titleEn: Green kindergartens for sustainable future
titleBg: Еко детски градини за устойчиво бъдеще (Зелени детски градини)
summaryEn:
The project aims to environmental protection and sustainable use of the common natural resources of the CBC area and it contributes by investing in green infrastructure and energy education in the cross-border region, particularly in kindergartens and with pre-school children. 
The project addresses: small scale investments in EE and RES in kindergartens in Strumica and Kyustendil (remodeling; equipment for “green” classrooms; construction of “green” playgrounds); implementing a joint capacity building programme for teachers; educating kindergarteners and parents on environmental protection and sustainable use of common natural resources, etc. Contractors will be engaged in order to perform reconstruction and other investment activities in the kindergartens in Strumica and Kyustendil. Further, external experts will be hired in order to develop and implement capacity building programme for teachers, to provide trainings to kindergarteners and parents on environmental protection and sustainable use of common natural resources, etc.
The kindergartens in Strumica and Kyustendil are expected to become “green” in order to environmental protection and sustainable use of the common natural resources and energy saving; Kindergarten teachers, kindergarten children and their parent areexpected to increas the knowledge on environmental protection and sustainable use of the common natural resources of the cross-border area; Cross-border networking and cooperation between kindergarten teachers, children and parents will be established.

titleEn: „Common actions for flood prevention in the cross-border region“
titleBg: Съвместни действия за превенция на наводненията в трансграничния регион
summaryEn:
On the territory of the project partners – Municipality of Rankovce and Municipality of Bobov dol is identified a common problem – frequent floods are seen caused by sectors in bad conditions of Goreshtitsa river in Bobov dol and Golem Dol in Rankovce causing problems and damage to the population of both municipalities. The current project proposes a common approach for tackling with the issue – similar investment measures on the riverbeds in both municipalities and conduct of awareness-raising campaigns among children after elaboration of a Joint strategy and methodology for environmental protection and flood prevention.
The main project result are: implemented construction works on Golem Dol in municipality of Rankovce - Phase 1 from km 0+000.00 to km 0+441.46, implemented measures for flood risk prevention and raised security from floods in municipality of Rankovce; implemented construction works on the shores of Goreshtitsa river – performed cleaning of the bed of Goreshtitsa river and placing of retaining walls, implemented measures for flood risk prevention and raised security from floods in municipality of Rankovce; elaborated trilingual Joint strategy and methodology for environmental protection and flood prevention (in English, Macedonian and Bulgarian language) and
conducted awareness-raising campaigns among children in schools in Rankovce and Bobov dol.
The project can be further developed in subsequent projects for prevention of flood risks in other parts of the rivers, also with different initiatives part of the municipals’ policies for prevention of other types of disasters – fires, earthquakes, etc.

titleEn: Innovative cooperation initiatives in cross border region
titleBg: Иновативна инициатива за сътрудничество в пограничния район
summaryEn: The project aims to stimulate productivity and competitiveness, economic growth and investments in the region, intensify cooperation between business and R&D sectors and contribution for provision of favorable environment for optimizing educational, professional qualification and re-qualification. The project aims too improve the competitiveness of the regional businesses, through development of two databases and creation of 1 CBC business network as an output of a survey of 5000 SMEs. The operation contributes to applying new innovative initiatives for cooperation through development of innovating business network, applying new approaches, new tools - VOFIS and VEP and training people and SMEs to benefit from them in order to jointly address common challenges. The project positively affecting group of 5000 SMEs - potential partners in a cross-border cluster in the forestry sector, including woodworking and furniture enterprises  and research, education and training institutions/centers from the cross-border eligible region.

titleEn: Virtuial Maritza - Merich Cuisine
titleBg: Виртуална кухня Марица - Мерич
summaryEn: Activity 1: Field surveys in Haskovo; Activity 2: Field surveys in Meric; Activity 3: Video cooking - Haskovo § Meric traditional recipes; Activity 4: Web platform "Virtual Chef" and "Haskovo & Meric cooking" application; Activity 5: Haskovo & Meric Cooking Festival; Activity 6: Information and Publicity in BG; Activity 7: Information § Publicity in Turkey.

titleEn: Measures for conservation and restoration of natural heritage in Bourgas and Enez
titleBg: Мерки за съхранение и възстановяване на природното наследство в Бургас и Енез
summaryEn: The main project activities include: cleaning and fortification of the channel Vaya lake - Black sea in Bourgas; delivery of a vertical profiling system for monitoring and maintenance of lake Gala's waters in Enez; conduction of a study on the ecological status of the waters of lakes Vaya (Bourgas) and Gala (Enez); implementation of a specialized training on environmental protection and preservation of biodiversity (2 modules - Burgas and Enez) with representatives of relevant stakeholders from Bourgas and Enez; development of a joint model and an assessment methodology for ecosystem services in lakes Vaya (Bourgas) and Gala (Enez); implementation of awareness-raising campaign in Burgas and Enez.

titleEn: Enhancing the tourism potential of  the Municipalities of Kyustendil and Konche - a sustainable joint future
titleBg: Повишаване на туристическия потенциал на общините Кюстендил и Конче - устойчиво съвместно бъдеще
summaryEn:
The project overall objective is to improve the accessibility to natural heritage in the municipalities of Kyustendil and Konche in order to utilize the potential of these resources for development of tourism from both side of the border region. 
Project activities includes: establishment transport and pedestrian access to natural landmark “Polska Skakavitsa Waterfall’’ – reconstruction of  municipal rural road, eco trails and areas for rest and observation - Municipality of Kyustendil and installation of urban equipment and for touristic settlement Mantovo, launching of eco trails and areas for rest and observation - Municipality of Konche;  conduction of thematic workshops "Appropriate bihaviour with the clients" and “Sustainable use of nature and culture for tourism development”; development of comprehensive study and presenting of the nature potentials for tourism development in Municipality of Kyustendil; presentation of the cultural and natural touristic potentials of Municipality of Konche; presentation of local tradition by local artists from both municipalities - music performances and exhibitions; organization of forums on "Partnering in tourism development" in both municipalities.
Favourable natural and environmental characteristics of the border area provide opportunities for sustainable development of different forms of tourism serve for development subsequent projects on both sides.

titleEn: Save the planet, save the future — save us!
titleBg: Да се спаси планетата, да се спаси бъдещето - СПАСЕТЕ НИ НАС!
summaryEn:
The overall objective of the project SAVE US is to offer knowledge to the youth from basic and high school for different possibilities for protection of environment around us, planet and cosmos. Project aims to presenting to the youth different kind of garbage, which is not just polluted environment but at the same time can be used for producing renewable energy, developing green economy and offer possibilities for promotion of business entrepreneurship, which will enable protection of the entire planet and create clean environment for the future generations. Project strives to explain to the youth the different kind of way of transformation of negative production and usage of energy in positive production of pure, renewable energy that not pollute environment and protect nature.
Educational material will be printed for polluted water, earth and air and how to use them for production of renewable energy, developing green economy and offer possibilities for promotion of business entrepreneurship. All of these will enable protection of the entire planet and create clean environment for us and for the future generations.

titleEn: Introduction of Renewable Energy Sources and Improving Energy Efficiency in Strumyani and Vasilevo
titleBg: Въвеждане на възобновяеми енергийни източници и подобряване на енергийната ефективност в Струмяни и Василево
summaryEn:
The current project is introducing energy efficient lighting in Strumyani and energy efficient building and lighting in Vasilevo. The project is educating the general public on environmental issues and raises their involvement and care for the environment. Thus it will have a long-term impact on lowering the electricity and heating consumption in the two municipalities, which is reducing the CO2 in the cross-border area. The administrations of Vasilevo and Strumyani reducing their costs respectively for school maintenance and street lighting.  The target investments reducing the CO2 emissions with 20 % for each of them by reduced the consumed energy with 35% in comparison with the start point of both the investments. The current project raised the capacity of local public institutions to implement EE measures and use RES.
Main outputs: exchanged expertise and capacity of 30 municipal administration representatives to apply EE policies, shared good and bad practices in EE management of public infrastructure in municipalities of Vasilevo and Strumyani; ensured engagement of external lecturer to present good samples EE methods and RES of public infrastructure from the cross-border area and abroad, thus providing opportunity for municipal staff to acknowledge with positive practices in the field of EE and RES in public infrastructure; raised capacity of 30 representatives of municipal administration and managers of public infrastructure of Strumyani and Vasilevo - the application of new technologies for distant management of heating systems, innovative isolation technologies, new EE heating, automatic management systems for control of lighting, RES in public infrastructure and its combined application; mounted 424 LED street lamps for safety of traffic and people overnight; reduction of CO2 emissions with 20 % generated by electricity consumption and reduction of the consumed energy by street lighting with 35% in comparison with the consumed energy before the introduction of LED lighting; improved energy performance of a municipal building with a surface at the floor of 121.41 m2, reduction of CO2 emissions with 20 % for the target investment in the Preliminary School “Goce Delcev” in Sedlarci and the consumed energy of the building will be lower with 20% in comparison with the start point of the investments.

titleEn: Protection of sustainable FOREst eCosystems in StrАndja/Yildiz mountain under climate changeS condiТions
titleBg: Защита на устойчиви горски екосистеми в Странджа / Йълдъз планина в условията на климатични промени
summaryEn:

Activity.

titleEn: Growth, Responsibility, partnErship, Ecology, Nature
titleBg: Растеж, Отговорност, Партньорство, Екология, Природа
summaryEn:
A 1: Project cycle management. Public procurement. Visibility actions.
A 2: Reconstruction works of a “GREEN HOUSE” in Sredets.
The general purpose is to reconstruct an old building in Sredets and the area around it and to turn it into a “Green House” – a centre for CBC education and networking for sustainable development.
A 3: Construction works and supervision of an "ECOLOGICAL CENTER" in Pinarhisar.
The general purpose is to create green infrastructure in Pinarhisar supportive for the joint sustainable development.
A 4: Joint awareness CAMPAIGN “SUSTAINABLE FOOD CONSUMPTION AND PRODUCTION”
The aim of the awareness campaign is to help local consumers understand the environmental impact of food products and support informed choices. It employs an innovative youth-led approach.
A 5: Site acceptance in Sredets and CBC WORKSHOP “SHAPING THE FUTURE – GOING GREEN”
The activity has to improve cooperation among policy makers, NGOs and associations of producers through information exchange, sharing of experience and best practices which to be used to improve the sustainability of local food chain – e.g. production of local organic food for the needs of the local kindergartens, schools, hospitals, etc.; stronger commitment toward supporting youth to increase their sustainable lifestyle.

titleEn: Energy Efficient Lighting in the Region Blagoevgrad - Delchevo
titleBg: Енергийно ефективно осветление в региона Благоевград - Делчево
summaryEn: The two partners initiated this project  to ensure better living conditions to their residents by ensuring energy efficient street lighting in the municipalities.The aim of the project is to ensure energy efficient lighting in 4 villages within Municipality of Blagoevgrad and 8 setlement in Municipality of Delchevo and to promote the sustainable use of the natural resources in the CB area through various thematic workshops on topics “Sustainable Use of the Natural Resources" and “Environment Protection”. During these workshops specific measures will be indicated for further common actions in the environmental sphere.The main outputs of the project are: ensured energy efficient street lighting in  villages within Municipality of Blagoevgrad – Logodazh, Padesh, Zelen Dol and Pokrovnik - replaced existing street lighting structures with new LED street lighting types and Developed intelligent management systems; ensured energy efficient street lighting in 7 villages within Municipality of Delchevo, as wel as in the town of Delchevo, as follows: village of Gabrovo, village of Dzvegor, village Razlovtsi, village Virche, village Grad, village Trabotivishte, village Stamer and the town of Delchevo; - ensured LED lights for public lighting - 28 W (600 pcs); - ensured LED lights for public lighting - 60 W (110 pcs); - ensured LED lights for public lighting - 100 W (50 pcs); Conducted 2 days workshop "Sustainable Use of the Natural Resources" in Delchevo; conducted 2 days  workshop "Environment Protection" in Blagoevgrad; The project is designed to have a great multiplier effect and potential for further development, as it starts the basis for common action on the topics of environment protection and common use of the natural resources in the CB area. During workshops on topics “Sustainable Use of the Natural Resources" and “Environment Protection” specific measures will be indicated for further common actions in the environmental sphere.

titleEn: Investing in youth capital through modernisation of cultural centres in the cross-border region
titleBg: Инвестиране в младежки капитал чрез модернизация на културни центрове в трансграничния регион

titleEn: Cross-border Partnership for Environmental Protection and Better Quality of Life
titleBg: Трансгранично сътрудничество за опазване на околната среда и по-добро качество на живот за опазване на околната среда и по-добро качество на живот
summaryEn:
The project aims to improve waste management and pollution prevention in the CB area improves knowledge related to the negative impact from improper waste collection, consequences to the environment and human life. The ambitious work programme of the project represents an integrated approach in the field of education as well as in community driven actions for removal of illegal dump sites and pollution prevention. This approach will be realized through the development of various tools (Joint Training Programme WasteEDU, EduBook “Lifecycle of waste”, mapping software and a web-portal) which could be utilized in the process of primary education of children, and promoted in the frame of various capacity building, training (Joint Green Schools and Camps) and networking events (Discussion forum and a Conference) that will be implemented during the action. 
The target groups that will be involved in the project are school students, primary schools, NGOs, branch associations and other organizations that support environmental and youth activities, SMEs working in the field of waste management, regional and local authorities.
As a result of the project, target groups will be provided with various tools for raising awareness and fostering direct involvement and participation of young people in environmental protection campaigns. In addition, project partners through various promotional and awareness raising activities will strive to increase the involvement of young people in solving issues related to waste reducing, recycling and prevention, as well as their knowledge on the benefits of reducing, recycling and properly managing waste.

titleEn: Fostering the creation of social enterprises by strengthening the entrepreneurial potential of young women
titleBg: Насърчаване на създаването на социални предприятия чрез укрепване на предприемаческия потенциал на младите жени
summaryEn:
FEMTERPRISE overall objective is to improve the conditions for business development in the cross-border area by applying innovative non-formal approach for strengthening the entrepreneurial capacity of female entrepreneurs aged 18-29 and fostering the creation of social enterprises.
FEMTERPRISE will research and identify potential female entrepreneurs, mentors, investors and business opportunities in the border area, empower 30 young women to successfully set-up their own enterprises and to provide innovative, sustainable solutions to social and environmental issues in the cross-border region by building their entrepreneurial, financial and leadership capacity, develop trilingual FEMTERPRISE online platform, promote entrepreneurial culture in the region by using ICT, impacting at least 3000 representatives of the target groups and establishing the cross-border FEMTERPRISE Network of Women Entrepreneurs. 
The project envisages multiple joint online and offline awareness-raising and promotion interventions as well as ICT cooperation for exchange of new ideas and fostering the creation of new social enterprises in the region.        
FEMTERPRISE will contribute to the improvement of the competitiveness of regional businesses by: 1) establishing a sustainable cross-border  FEMTERPRISE Network of Women Entrepreneurs; 2) strengthening the entrepreneurial capacity and creating opportunities for professional and social realization of young female entrepreneurs; 3)developing innovative, sustainable and supportive online tool for capacity building, mentoring and networking between female entrepreneurs, mentors, clients and potential investors from the cross-border region; 4) fostering the creation of female –run social enterprises in the region; 5)promoting entrepreneurial culture and social entrepreneurship.

titleEn: Raising the competitiveness of regional tourism by supporting the development of rural and cultural tourism in the cross-border area of Bulgaria and Macedonia
titleBg: Подобряване конкурентоспособността на туризма в региона чрез развитие на селския и културен туризъм в трансграничния регион на България и Македония
summaryEn:
The project aims to improve  the competitiveness of the regional tourism by developing various integrated products and the implementation of networking activities and events to supporting the development of the rural and cultural tourism in the CB area.
Other outcomes resulting from the implementation of the diverse work programme of the project include: - Developed various innovative and web-based tools to promote the cultural heritage and the sustainable tourism potential of the CB area; - Fostered experience and know-how exchange between tourism operators and stakeholders of the CB area of both countries for sustainable utilization and advertising of the non-material cultural heritage as well as the rural tourism potentials of the common border region; - Established a solid foundation (resources and information) to build upon when developing new tourism products promoting the sustainable utilization of the cultural heritage of the region; - Developed and promoted innovative tool to improve quality of the provided tourist offer in the CB region by enhancing the client / provider relations and improving the quality of the provided tourist service based on real client feedback; - Developed and promoted a single online resource of endangered of desolation authentic settlements, traditions and customs of the CB area; - Analyzed and promoted the material and non-material cultural heritage of the region in order to boost the tourism potential and attractiveness of the CB area.

titleEn: Creative Entrepreneurship Network
titleBg: Мрежа за творческо предприемачество
summaryEn:
The project will contribute to the main objective “to intensify cross-border cooperation between the people and institutions of the region in order to jointly address common challenges and exploit untapped potentials” through forming environment to unlock creativity, in particular of young people, to develop tools as mobile creative atelies/workshops in local communities and entrepreneurial skills to untap the potential of creative industries.
Selection of participants- 40 BG and 40 MK participants to be selected; establishment of 6 mobile ateliers/workshops; Creative Forum in Strumica –for 20 Mk and 20 BG participants for creative ideas and creative networking and cooperation; Capacity Building for creative ideas and entrepreneurship -  training for 10 MK and 10 BG  trainers "Development of creative products" and Creative workshops trainings on Film and clip making for 10 Mk and 10 BG participants, on Music workshop - 10 BG participants, on Arts and crafts mobile workshop for 40 participants, on Mask and costumes for 10 Mk participants  and Creative Entrepreneurship training and Opportunity to finance a creative business for 30 participants; Creative Fair in Blagoevgrad district for 20 BG and 20 Mk the most active participants from all 6 creative workshops to make creative products prototypes; Intensive learning in EU country – study visit and good practice exchange; Cross - border Exhibition "Creativity and Entrepreneurship in Strumica to present the results and lessons learnt.
Target groups are young people with creative orientation and skills from local schools, universities and local business; unemploued people with creative potential; 35 community centres.
The project is a piloting project for encouraging creative entrepreneurship within the cross - border region and the lessons learnt and experience will be used for the idea of development support ecosystem for creative enterprises and international promotion of cross-border entrepreneurship. There is opportunity for further development of the project for support and promotion of start -ups of the creative businesses at Balkan level i.e. the new programme Balkan - Med for Balkan-Med network for creative entrepreneurship as well as Erasmus+ for new entrepreneurs.

titleEn: Think Composting - dedication to the organic full circle
titleBg: Компостирай – насочени към природосъобразният начин на живот
summaryEn:
The project aims to increase the public awareness about environmental protection and protection of natural resources using the organic waste to create organic fertilizer - Composter in the cross-border region. 
With the implementation of the project promotional video will be produced that will explain the concept of composting (usage of the composting containers and the benefits for the households) and to promote the project. The raw video material recorded during the production of the promotional video will be used to produce a short TV announcement to call the interested households to apply and receive a composting container that will be supplied with this project. In the framework of the project, brochure will be prepared and printed and every citizen that will receive a composter as well as persons who will attend at the project events will get this brochure. Info days will be implemented where citizens will get their composters and will be trained in their use. The Studies that will be prepared in the frame of this project will provide information about the composting potentials in the cross-border region.
Throughout the implementation of the project activities, municipalities from the two regions will be involved and be part of the processes of training, information about the benefits of composting and partitioning of the composters between citizens.
This project aims to show that protecting the environment is one of the main priorities of the region, the usage of the organic waste in a manner that will not only reduce the pollution, but will improve the quality of the land through the produced organic compost. Raising the public awareness and the example that should be given to the citizens of the region is the main benefit of this project.

titleEn: Grounds for better future of our youth
titleBg: Основи за по-добро бъдеще на нашите младежи
summaryEn:
1.Designing of Joint Logo


2.Designing of a joint tri-lingual website 


3.Works on the youth-related facility (located in the Cultural-Educational Center (KOC) in Boljevac)

5.Elaboration of Study and analysis on the potential of the Cross-border region to reduce youth immigration.

9.“Children&Parents Services Entrepreneur”, Workshop in Chiprovtsi.
