11.Presentation for high-school students on enterpreneurship oportunities.

titleEn: Promotion of rural and mountain tourism through the use of ICT, ISO consultations and Incentive travel method between Bulgaria and FYROM
titleBg: Насърчаване на селския и планинския туризъм чрез използване на ИКТ, ISO консултации и метод на туристическия стимул  между България и Бивша югославска република Македония
summaryEn:
This project overall objective is to propose an innovative way of boosting the tourists' flows between regions by promoting the cross-border cooperation between people ( employers, employees) and institutions (tourist actors, attractions, local authorities). The Incentive travel methods and programs are a new way of exploiting untapped potentials of the cross-border region and will intensify the cross-border tourism movement.
The main activities that this project incorporates are: ISO Consultations for 12 tourist actors, the Incentive travel research - is a business travel that is designed to motivate or trigger action, as a reward for these actions from employees or business partners, trilingual book will be printed and disseminated in all municipalities of the selected area presenting the Incentive travel method as a tool to enhance the economic appeal of the cross border region, webpage of the project will be attached to the already existing website of project FRESH.AIR and will be updated properly during the project's implementation.
Project Results Increased competitiveness for the tourist actors after being consulted on integration of ISO standards(12 organizations); increased cross-border movement of people and exchange of good and services in the area after the Incentive travel research and dissemination of its results; publishment and dissemination of tourist bulletin (4 editions) in favor of the incentive travel packages and vouchers to promote the cross border movement.

titleEn: Belasitsa - The Mountain of the Active People
titleBg: Беласица - планината на активните хора
summaryEn:
The main objective of the project is to increase the popularity of Belasitsa and raise the competitiveness of the CBC region’s tourist offer on trans-border scale. A number of alternative tourist initiatives will be organized, promoted and held in the two countries. There are 5 joint touristic products/events: Belasitsa Active Weekend (consisting of three trail running, one mountain bike and promotional side events); Bike Tour Belasitsa; Belasitsa Bike for children; elaboration of 2 thematic bike trails. Additionally 3 joint leaflets, 5 promotional video clips and 1 short film are planned to reach more than 8000 people. 
The expected project results are: creation of sustainable alternative tourism products/events; demonstration of the potential of the cross-border area of Belasitsa for alternative active tourism; creation of a common image of Belasitsa cross border region; raise the competitiveness of the CBC region’s tourist offer; and creation of numerous personal and professional contacts between bikers, trail runners and visitors from the two countries.

titleEn: Strengthening Tourist Entrepreneurship and Promotion of Services
titleBg: Подкрепа за предприемачеството и популяризиране на услугите в туризма
summaryEn: The project is focused on activities related to addressing the challenge and exploiting the potential for improving quality of tourist offer through the provision of the needed key business skills and creating possibilities for self-employment (predominantly of young people). The project establish a relaible model for resolving problems and addressing the needs of local communities with the aim to increase the opportunity for smart economic growth on local and trans-border level. This project aims creating opportunities for employment of young people, stimulating social links and exchange, maintaining good neighbour relations. Exchange of information and capacity building of tourism sector development through developing of project Action Plan for fostering entrepreneurship in tourism, Specialized training for young entrepreneurs in tourism, Online platform for business consultations in tourism and Online consultations for start-ups in the sector of tourism.

titleEn: Joint training program for forest fire prevention and management
titleBg: Съвместна тренировъчна програма за превенция и управление на горски пожари

titleEn: Prevention and minimization of the Risks for the Environment and Vision for iNnovative Tools
titleBg: Превенция и минимизиране на рисковете за околната среда и визия за иновативни способи
summaryEn:
A Kick-off meeting between the legal representatives and technical and financial experts of the two project partners will be held in the premises of the Lead Partner in Dimitrovgrad and a Project Partnership Agreement will be signed by the Mayor of Dimitrovgrad and the Mayor of Uzunkopru.
The project partners, fire-fighting institutions in the two municipalities, and other institutions responsible for protection of the population on both sides of the border, will create a formal cooperation network working on the prevention and mitigation of the consequences from natural and man-made disasters. The network will work towards capacity building, raising the awareness of prevention activities, developing joint risk assessment strategies, improved coordination, trainings in the use of ICT technologies, including introduction of new methods, exchange of experience, know-how and good practices (study visits, round-tables, conferences, and others.
The main project activities are supply of equipment and work and supervision for the installation of the Automatic Observatory Tower for the LP and supply of equipment and work and supervision for the installation of Flood Prevention Information System for The Project Partner – Uzunköprü.
To ensure the sustainability of the project there will be elaborated a Common Strategy for Prevention from Natural and Man-made Disasters and mitigating the consequences from them across the Cross border region.
For disseminating the project’s results will be held Opening and Final press conferences and a Discussion forum "Prevention and mitigation of the consequences from natural and man-made disasters" A total of six publications in the media will be made to inform the local communities. Promotion materials for the project and the cross-border region activities will be elaborated /500 project brochures; 200 bags, 200 pens, 200 USBs and 200 CDs for the initiatives/. Information boards will be placed on the main buildings of the two partners.

titleEn: Promotion of Decentralized Energy Production from Renewable Energy Sources
titleBg: Насърчаване на децентрализирано производство на енергия от възобновяеми енергийни източници
summaryEn:
Project aims to support establishment of an integrated approach in the Crossborder (CB) area of energy production of renewables and wide introduction of energy efficiency solutions. Realization of the project will stimulate local business and will contribute for optimizing overall energy consumption and costs. One of the key objectives is to improve the awareness and raise the interest of the target group and stakeholders from CB area on decentralized energy solutions utilizing the potential of RES and their main benefits: environmental; economic (reduced costs and energy independence); efficiency (power quality and resilience); resource conservation (using of RES); reliability and security. In this regards the project will aim to promote the concept, main technologies and benefits for individual houses, business and public facilities.
The project will be implemented through work program containing among others information and awareness raising campaign  “Solar Rooftop” consisting of 6 information and awareness workshops; Solar Investment guides for three type of users –private households, SMS’s public institutions; Web portal – “EnerGain” home energy and advice web-site and educational movies – an elaborate online resource that will provide potential users with present day information and competent advices on modern solutions for energy efficient and environmental friendly home, business or a public building; Joint specialized trainings of RES technicians and engineers - part of Capacity building, experience and exchange of know-how programme for professionals and practitioners in the field of RES and EE; as well as E-Learning Training Programme “EnerGAIN”. 
All of the abovementioned will contribute for improving the capacity for environmental protection and sustainable use of common natural resources in the CB area.

titleEn: Green building for common green future
titleBg: Зелени сгради за общо зелено бъдеще
summaryEn: The project will create better conditions for a more sustainable energy future in the Cross Border  region  through construction of energy-efficient public buildings, improving of awareness of population and stakeholders for the benefits of the energy efficiency measures and increasing of capacity of public administration staff for energy efficiency measures and climate change, promoting energy efficiency as tools for achieving sustainable development and improving the quality of life in cross border region.Project activities included: capacity building for climate change, public awareness raising campaign, capacity building-green infrastructure, reconstruction of the Municipal building - Kocani , reconstruction of the Regional Administration building in Blagoevgrad, thematic workshops and campaign tour, development of Regional energy strategy – Blagoevgrad. The project will have long-term positive impact on environment in the CB region and will improve quality of life through improvement of air quality. With the implementation of planed works for the public buildings, cost for electricity and heating fuel should be reduced approximately for 3 % annually.  Achievements of the project will be used as a basis for recommendation for defining environmental sector specific policies, strategies and actions, which will be further developed by the teams of both partners, by the local authorities, by the universities and NGOs that work in the area of the protection of environment.

titleEn: Increasing the operational capacity for forest fires and improving prevention of disasters
titleBg: Повишаване на оперативния капацитет при горски пожари и подобряване превенцията от бедствия
summaryEn:
Activity.

1. Project management and organization.
Activity.

2. Preparation, organization and implementation of public procurement procedures - preparation of the technical specifications and other documentation according PRAG.
Activity.

3.Supply of special equipment for forest fires- 3 vehicles plus personal equipment for Bulgarian partner and 1 vehicle for the Turkish partner.
Activity.

4. Establishing study rooms intended for training youths - school rooms in the buildings of the partners that will be used for training children.
Activity.

5. Preparation of a Guide on fire safety and civil protection with common preventive methods suitable for children.
Activity.

6.Training of trainers for work with children and preparation of training materials.
Activity.

7.Training of children for reaction in case of forest fires and other disasters.
Activity.

8. Field exercises and demonstrations with the new equipment and with the children.
Activity.

9. Information and publicity activities during the whole project.

titleEn: Cross-border cooperation for preparedness and reaction in case of floods
titleBg: Трансгранично сътрудничество в подготовката и борбата с наводнения
summaryEn:
1. Project management.

2. Training Programme elaboration.

3. Equipment delivery.

4. Standard Operational Procedure elaboration.

5. Joint field exercise scenario preparation.

6. Training courses for management and operational staff.

7. Joint field exercise.

8. Information and publicity.

titleEn: Joint integrated policy for low-carbon economy in cross-border region
titleBg: Съвместна интегрирана политика за нисковъглеродна икономика в трансграничния регион
summaryEn:
Project goal is to contribute on environmental protection and sustainable use of the common natural resources of the CBC area, trough practical implementation of the measures and actions leading towards reduction of carbon emissions and promotion of energy efficiency, renewable energy use and green technologies.
Key project action is elaboration of Joint cross-border low-carbon economy policy paper and establishing Joint cross border network for monitoring of implementation, with active participation of representatives of municipalities, business entities, public institutions and relevant NGOs in 9 border municipalities. As a start-up information concerning carbon emission in the region Analysis of the situation will be done, as well as  Air quality monitoring of pollutants PM10 (particulate matters), nitrogen oxide, sulphur dioxide, ozone and carbon monoxide. Additionally a system for coordination, information and experience exchange between the project municipalities will be jointly developed and joint workshops and study tours will be held on in both project regions. Informative public campaign on Climate change and the importance of lowering the Carbon footprint will be realized in order to raise awareness about this issue and enhance public discussions.
Impact of the project is toward joint protection and monitoring of natural resources, as well as creating prerequisite for sustainable development in this cross-border area. Joint analysis of carbon emissions in the region will show the real state of the CO2 emission, also giving ideas about its possibilities and the need for reduction. Join policy for low-carbon economy will contribute towards sustainable cross-border development. The project implementation will contribute as well to establishing of direct contacts between the local actors in both border regions, for experience exchange, practices and partnership ideas.

titleEn: Joint actions for fire fighting
titleBg: Съвместни дейности за борба с пожарите
summaryEn: The main activities of the project include development of risk analysis of fire hazards in the municipalities of Uskup and Sungurlare and guide on best practices for firefighting, supply of firefighting equipment for both municipalities including highpowered rucks with mountable fireplatforms for fighting forest fires and elaboration of works design of firetowers for the municipality of Sungurlare.

titleEn: Sustainable Tourism Development - Asset Cross-Border Cohesion and Prosperity
titleBg: Устойчивото развитие на туризма - актив за трансгранично сближаване и просперитет
summaryEn:
The focus of the project is to systematize and update the information about the trails offered in Blagoevgrad District and the East Planning Region. The created database will contain unified information about all tourist trails in the region with GPS mapping, which will be placed in Google Map with markers and options for visualization of textual, photo and video information. The database will contain information about all tourist sites, destinations, calendar of events such as religious holidays, festivals, rituals, exhibitions, concerts, municipal events, etc. This platform will allow to model traveling by several commands on the computer of mobile devices. The management and maintenance of the platform will be shared among the municipalities and the tourist organization and companies working in the field of tourism in the corresponding municipality. A common standard will be established for the creation of tourist trails for the purpose of their easy adaptation and uploading into the common database. Series of joint initiatives,trainings, competition and campaigns are going to be addressed to various target groups.
By implemention of the project - Research will be done, information about the itineraries offered in Blagoevgrad District and the East Planning Region will be collect, systematize and popularized, two tourist products and one on-line service in support of all-year round tourism will be created as well.
Common initiatives (trainings, workshop, webinar, tourist fora); two new regional tourist trails developed and promoted via an advertisement clip, digital walk and a brochure; guidebook prepared for guides and animators in tourism; Trained at least 25 persons from the target municipalities for guides and animators in tourism; Provided equipment to conduct the training, to use for actualization of database in future and for the trained people to be able to creation and tracking of new tourist trails and their integrate into the platform in future.

titleEn: Energy Efficiency In Order to Achieve a Better Environment in Kindergartens
titleBg: "Енергийна ефективност с цел постигане на по-добра среда в детските градини"
summaryEn:
The project will increase the knowledge and awareness of sustainable living and the environmental impact and benefits of sustainable energies. The improvement of the kindergarten will reduce energy waste, improve health of the beneficiaries and promote a dialogue on the topic of our "environmental footprint”. The trainings aim to introduce and establish sustainable lifestyles to the beneficiaries through information, meeting the requested soft measures.
The trainings will target a community need by raising the general knowledge of the population in the matter of renewable and sustainable energies.  The trainings aim to introduce and establish sustainable lifestyles to the beneficiaries through an information, meeting the requested soft measures.
The main outputs are: improved knowledge and awareness of the collaborative project and increased communication and collaboration between the two municipalities; Improved, energy efficient Kindergarten of municipality of Sandanski that provides a healthy and safe place for the children to grow and learn: major roof repairs, repair compromised sections on the lower, ground level parts of the ground. Repair works aimed at restoring the damaged plaster; Implementation of energy efficiency measures - hermal insulation of the external layer on the facades, roofs and floors of the building, according to energy efficiency investment projects; rehabilitatated Kindergarten in Novo Selo; the increased knowledge in the area of clean soil, air, water and forest and in the area of energy efficiency and practical implementation; energy efficiency website: an Informational section, Energy Efficiency E-Calculator, and a Company Database including a user review section, an online forum for opinions, questions;
There will be campaigns in both municipalities in an open space, to raise awareness of environmental impact and to help popularize the project.

titleEn: Culinary Neighborhood Network
titleBg: Мрежа Кулинарен Комшулук
summaryEn: Activities run parallel in both cross border regions - Fieldwork and ethnographical study prepared and carried out in both countries, Analysis of the supply/demand of rural tourism products in the border area prepared in Turkey, 2 Joint Capacity Building Trainings - for public sector representatives in Pomorie and Tourism SME representatives in Keshan, Communication, logistics, visibility activities - design, elaboration of printed materials for visibility and communication, 2 Food Festivals - 1 Opening in Pomorie and 1 Closing in Keshan.

titleEn: The Digital Nature
titleBg: Дигитална природа
summaryEn: The project aims to contribute sustainable development of the BG-MK border region and its improved image by stimulating the harnessing of its untapped potential for nature tourism. The project aims too increase: 1/the tourist attractiveness of the natural sites in the BG-MK cross-border region through their digitization and 2/the tourism visibility of natural attractions in the BG-MK cross-border region by their promoting as a joint tourist destination. Providing quality and innovative digital content about impressive natural sites in the region, easily accessible by Internet. Cooperative the efforts of researchers, IT, photography, printing-and-publishing, marketing and linguistic experts from BG and MK border regions for addressing the common challenge of raising the attractiveness and visibility of natural sites and assets in the region and help harness the untapped potential for nature tourism. Further boosting the tourist competitiveness of the cross-border region by creating and releasing an up-to-date digital data base of local providers of nature tourism services and products and their tourism offers in 3 languages: BG, MK and EN. Joint project promoting achieved via a 3-lingual website, media publications, catalogues, leaflets, a fair, a festival, mini cards, etc.

titleEn: “Building the bridge of tourism  -  blend of common heritage”
titleBg: Да изградим мост на туризма - обща бленда на наследтво
summaryEn:
The project idea is to present in an attractive way cultural diversity of the location by building a new, contemporary touristic information centre in Staro Nagoricane Municipality and making a unique cultural monument Ch. Saint Archangel Mihail - Rila into finished product for cultural tourism and with the "Bridge of tourism" to pass from the past to the modern times and to create various other forms of tourism products based on common intangible cultural values, legends, folklore, crafts. 
The project objective is diversification of tourist products through cooperation in the border region. 
Project activities are: execution of works for reconstruction of the old cooperative building in Mlado Nagoricane and supply of necessary items for equipping the Tourist Information Centre; execution of the architectural restoration of the church “Saint Archangel Mihail”; 
The envisaged outputs contained:  
professional videos and photographs for the exhibition areas of the Touristic Information Centre;  local women receive professional and practical training in the Handcraft educational centre in the designated exhibition area of the Touristic Information Centre; two entertaining games in form of mobile applications; developed and introduced on the website: project website featuring project news, CBC cultural heritage info, and promoting the attractions created, and securing appropriate visibility of the both the project and CBC touristic offer; two day Viewing tour, including final event for participants from different stakeholders, including participants from Bulgaria, organised in the end of the project - one by Staro Nagoricane Municipality and one by Rila Municipality.

titleEn: Let's write fairytale for Burgas and Edirne
titleBg: Да напишем приказка за Бургас и Одрин
summaryEn:
1. Set up of a network among educational and cultural institutions across the border "Children and the cultural heritage" One expert and one photographer per country will work together. They will gather information and will provide pictures, photographs of the nature and cultural heritage of the cross-border region. This activity has crucial importance as before starting the main work under the project, there must be present sufficient information about the region.

2.Elaboration of interactive children's game "Heritages of the cross-border region" The interactive game will be elaborated by an external IT expert working in close connection with experts and teachers from both kindergartens. The content for the interactive game will be provided by the expert group. The game will include at least 20 landmarks from both partner regions, there will be also at least 10 levels of the game, options for play from two players at the same time, options for team contest, etc. The platform will be user-friendly and will invite young learners to be active participants.The game will be uploaded in Internet and will be available in Bulgarian, Turkish and English language.

titleEn: Development of the tourism in cross border region Bosilovo-Garmen by preservation of the local cultural traditions
titleBg: Развитие на туризма в трансграничния регион Босилово - Гърмен, чрез запазване на местните културни традиции
summaryEn:
The project aims to enhance the tourist potential in the cross-border region through rehabilitation of community centers and preservation of local cultural traditions. Specific project objectives are:  Rehabilitation of the community center in Sekirnik, Bosilovo; Rehabilitation of the community center in Ribnovo, Garmen and Better tourist services.
Main outputs are: Rehabilitated municipal building of the community center in Sekirnik and building of the community center in Ribnovo.  Improved condition of the public buildings and enhancement of their energy efficiency, fully equipped community center in Ribnovo, assured proper equipment for development and exposition of a local cultural tradition in the cross-border area- the custom of "Ribnovo marriage", new tourist service developed and ready for exposition and visiting, conducted folklore festival in the cross-border area and presented culture traditions, new tourist products developed and increased opportunities for tourists’ attraction; Partnerships established in the field of tourism. The renewed public infrastructure could become places for future touristic and cross-border cooperation and provide significant possibilities for realization of numerous programs, festivals, events, workshops about historical and cultural heritage, sustainable development, nature preservation, regional identity, etc.

titleEn: “Joint investments in energy effectiveness”
titleBg: Съвместни инвестиции в енергийна ефективност
summaryEn:
This project is directed to reducing energy consumption in municipality buildings with public functions and thus will affect the development of environment protection activities, which for its part would have a positive impact on improving the quality of life for people on both sides of the border in cross border region.
The overall objective is to prevent the environment through reduction of energy consumption in the municipal buildings in Rila and Probishtip.
The envisaged main outputs are:  enhanced capacity of municipalities teams in in the field of local sustainable energy planning; rehabilitated municipal buildings in Rila and Probishtip - Improved condition of the public buildings and enhancement of its energy efficiency; reduced expenses in municipality budgets through saving energy; extended exploitation of public infrastructure; Improved comfort of public buildings; reducing carbon emissions from public buildings; ensured access of people with disabilities to the buildings; Implemented actions for environmental protection in the cross-border area; conducted energy efficiency seminar in Rila; strengthen relationships between the municipality of Rila and municipality of Probishtip and expert level of colaboration; raised awareness of new methods in energy consumption reduction; analyzing new technologies and approaches that can improve efficiency uptake; and examining a new regulatory structure to support new approaches to energy efficiency.

titleEn: Cross-Border Fun Center
titleBg: Трансграничен център за забавления
summaryEn: Activity 1: Formation of the Fun Center Network - selection of 5 tourism 'knots' at each side of the border in Blagoevgrad District and South-East Planning Region. Activity 2: Development of new tourism offers - group visits to each of the 10 tourism 'knots' for the planning of new services and products. Activity 3: Development of Internet platform for the CBFC network - a unique promotional and selling point for the Fun Center network. Activity 4: Marketing of the CBFC product - production and dissemination of flyer for the Center; making of souvenirs; media publications and Grand Opening event.

titleEn: Improvement of sports infrastructure as the basis for the development of young sport talents
titleBg: Подобряване на спортната инфраструктура като база за развитие на млади спортни таланти

titleEn: Youth networking towards sustainable tourism development
titleBg: Младежки инициативи за развитие на устойчив туризъм
summaryEn:
The project objective is to promote the common actions for development of sustainable tourism through reducing “Brain drain” and preventing the migration of young and skilled people in the cross-border region by acquiring new knowledge and skills.

Within the framework of the project, a joint cross-border club "YOUTH TOUR" is planned to be established in the two partner schools from Burgas, Bulgaria and Uzunkopru, Turkey. The members of the club will analyse and create a database of touristic objects from the region - historical monuments, places for accommodation and leisure, etc. They will popularize the club in the social media and will make survey for rating the most attractive touristic objects from the cross-border region.

An innovative platform YOUTH TOUR will be created. The platform will provide detailed information in various areas connected to tourism education, opportunities for young people and cross-border promotion. An event will be organized - a tourist online marketing conference (Camp), which will show the newest information on online tourism in an interesting way for young people. A photo exhibition is planned in Burgas, where students will take their memories from practical trainings in pictures and use them for joint cross-border photo exhibition named "Memories from our homelands".

A tourism fair for youth tourism will be organized by the Turkish partner. The exhibition will show the unique beauties of the cross-border region as well as its tourism potential as a base for development of sustainable tourism.

The results of the project are mainly social and economic - students getting to know more about their homeland and their neighbours from the other side of the border and raising awareness of the attractiveness of the cross-border region. The implementation of the project will contribute to attracting new tourists and presenting new opportunities for learning and training for young people oriented to the demands of the labour market in the cross-border region.

titleEn: Intelligent strategic cross-border development for response in case of major natural and man-made hazards and disasters
titleBg: Интелигентно стратегическо транснационално развитие за реакция в случай на мащабни природни и причинени от човека опасности и бедствия

titleEn: CROSS BORDER CENTER FOR SUPPORT OF ROMA BUSINESS
titleBg: Трансграничен център за подкрепа на ромски бизнес
summaryEn: The main objective of the project is to increase the competitiveness of regional businesses by providing support for innovative and creative ideas of women and young people from the Roma community to start their own business.  The project aims too providing best practices, establishing contacts with successful entrepreneurs and visiting businesses, establishing relations with representatives of business organizations, trainings and mentoring to develop a business plan and promoting cross-border cooperation between entrepreneurs and realization of joint project activities. Establishing of Cross-Border Center supports development of Roma Business on both sides of the border and partnership and cooperation between Roma entrepreneurs from the border region. The project address to capacity building among Roma youth and women and entrepreneurs from both municipalities Blagoevgrad and Kochani, improving the quality of life of Roma, their families and economic development in the border region.

titleEn: Construction of systems for prevention and early warning of floods
titleBg: Изграждане на система за превенция и ранно предупреждение от наводнения
summaryEn:
The aim of the project is to ensure a positive significant impact, sustainable change and durable improvement within the eligible cross-border area, regarding flood-risk assessment, prevention, management and mitigation of floods on the territory of Valandovo and Kresna Municipality. The objectives are: To achieve an integrated monitoring, evaluation and prevention of flooding in the cross-border region, through introduction of specific water monitoring equipment; To improve the emergency preparedness and intervention in cases of flooding, by introducing a joint system for flood-risk management in both municipalities; To contribute to developing uniform cross-border concept for hydro-meteorological phenomena risk assessment, development of joint risk assessment, capacity building. 
This will be achieved with supply of specific equipment for water monitoring (purchasing and supply of 2 two measure station), in Valandovo Municipality and Kresna Municipality, which will be installed on some identified dangerous parts in the basins on two rivers in both municipalities, Valandovo and Kresna. The equipment will be connected to the joint integrated monitoring system, which will be purchased and installed in Valandovo, but will be used by both municipalities via internet connection.
Two detailed work project of flood - risk zones across the riverbeds in the target cross-borders municipalities will be prepared, including photographing, evaluation and analysis of the current situation.

titleEn: Platform for cross-border festival tourism in the field of culture and traditions
titleBg: Платформа за трансгранично фестивален туризъм в областта на културата и традициите - ФОЛКЛОР
summaryEn: Project focuses on development and encouragement of cross border cooperation in the area of rural and festival tourism amongst the public institutions and other stakeholders in tourism sector through organization of common festival, transfer of knowledge and experience. Also the project will build the tolerance and respect towards cultures and tradition of different ethnics in both regions. Project has a fairly sizeable impact on joint presentation of common traditional and cultural heritage as a tool for sustainable tourist development of cross border region through popularization of the values of the tradition and folklore. Particularly, the CB impact is summarized as follows: Presentation of mutual cultural folklore and musical heritage; supporting of cooperation in the area of rural development; Supportive investments and supply in cultural and festival infrastructure and public facilities. The joint staffing & financing, equal participation of the team members during the implementation of the project, the participation of tourist enterprises, NGOs and local authority representatives from both countries at the planned project events, study tour and in the process of preparation of study for development of rural tourism in municipality of Pehcevo will have direct and significant impact on numerous of future cooperation activities in the area of tourism and culture. Also project will contribute to the sustainable development by adding values on the tourist products.  Good practice from rural tourism presented which will serve as an example for followers after the project expires and will guarantee the sustainability of the outcomes of the project.

titleEn: UNITED CROSS BORDER INITIATIVES FOR PROTECTION OF ENVIRONMENT OF THE BULGARIA-TURKEY AREA
titleBg: Обединени трансгранични инициативи за опазване на околната среда в региона на България - Турция.
summaryEn: Visualization and publicity activities will be carried out by PP2 in Aytos. Selection of contractor and supply of equipment for seperate waste collection in province of Edirneand Aytos will be conducted by each partner. Following purchasement activities training of municipal workers for seperate collection of green waste will be ornazized in Aytos; 2 days workshop will be held in Edirne with the participation of both sides. Awaraness compaign will be held in Edirne Centre and towns; a Final Forum including "Let's celan our town together" event will be organized in Aytos.

titleEn: "Protecting the population in the municipalities of Karbinci and Strumiani and prevention of flood damage"
titleBg: "Защита на населението в общините Карбинци и Струмяни и предотвратяване на щетите от наводненията"
summaryEn:
The project aims at restoring the normal social and economic life of over 7977 people. It proposes a complex decision of the problems with high waters in two of the worst affected municipalities - Karbinci and Strumiani. The project includes as a main activity the corection of river Kozjachka in Karbinci and river Shashka in Strumiani that has been destroyed and threatens the health of citizens in the both Municipalities. The project envisages the construction works in both municipalities and supervisions of the sites. The project was developed on the basis of preliminary studies and analyzes the status of the two watercourses. Realization of the project will ensure the safety and health of the population in the target region.
The main project result will be the raised safety of local population from Strumyani and Karbinci from natural disasters and prevented flooding for the main settlements of the two municipalities. Project outputs are related to prevention of flood disasters in urbanized territory of Strumyani and Karbinci trough correction, building of protective walls and cleaning of: 256 meters of the Kozjachka riverbed and for Shashka river to solve section of the gully between threshold 4 and threshold 28 with axial length of 340 m and a total length of 682 m retaining walls. The main project result will also 
raised capacity of 30 representatives of municipal administration and experts from other responsible insitutions acting in the field of desasters of karbinci and Strumyani (like RIEWs, Basin Directorate, Municipality of Strumini, Karbinci Municipality, NGOs, District administration etc.) including youths and roma and disabled people. The target group will be introduced to the application of new technoligies in the field of disaster management, the posibilities for partnership in the prevention of disasters, the role of population in the disaster prevention etc. The monitoring of the river beds and their cleaning will be done regular not less then 5 years after the project and will be distributed and communicated to all relevant authorities, which have the responsibility of sustainable management and prevention of disasters.

titleEn: Improvement of the capacity for nature protection by enhancement of the cooperation between young environmentalists in Bolyarovo – Kofcaz municipalities Project
titleBg: Подобряване на капацитета за защита на природата чрез подобряване на сътрудничеството между младите еколози в общините Болярово - и Кофчаз
summaryEn: Development of environmental course module, Delivery of environmental course "Young ecologists"; Development of Balkan Youth Environment Observatory platform;Development of study of best marketing practices for popularization of nature protection measures among young people;Development of study on innovative methods for sustainable use of common natural resources;Organization of social media campaign for popularization of nature protection measures among young people.

titleEn: Measures to create the conditions for prevention and rapid response to day-to-day events in Chiprovtsi and Bolevac
titleBg: Мерки за създаване на условия за предотвратяване и бърза за реакция при навднения в Чипровци и Болевац
summaryEn: Purchase of work machines and a transportation vehicle planned for the works on the watercourses of rivers of the municipality of Boljevac; Study on the acting and elaboration of new crisis action plans in the CB region; Purchase of work machines for municipality of Chiprovci; Cleaning of тhe river banks in Ogosta river; Training for representatives of local authorities at the municipal level and representatives of local community councils from municipalities of Boljevac and Chiprovtsi; Training for inhabitants of the villages at the highest risk of floods in Boljevac and Chiprovtsi; Researches on threatened by floods areas in the CBC region.

titleEn: Preparation and promotion of the process of development of European ecological network NATURA2000 in Istranca Mountain
titleBg: Подготовка и популяризиране на процеса на изграждане на Европейска екологична мрежа НАТУРА 2000 в Странджа планина
summaryEn:
1. Demonstration of process for designation of NATURA 2000 sites in Istranca.

2. Study visit in Bulgaria for presenting the European experience in establishment of NATURA 2000.

3. On-site training for joint data collection at NATURA 2000 sites in.

4. Publication and dissemination of information materials.

5. Organization of local workshops on NATURA 2000.

titleEn: Prevention of risk for sustainable development of the region
titleBg: Превенция на риска за устойчиво развитие на региона
summaryEn: During the project different activities in the area of risk prevention, risk investigation, risk training protection of the disasters will be organized. An investigation on the risks, occurred in the past as well as assessment of current risky zones will be done with a collection of data base for preparation of risk map of the TBR.The processed data would be presented in three different reports. Using different risk assessment methods such as FMEA and RFMEA, HAZOP, MOZAR, etc. the most often emerging risk would be assessed and would color the zones of TBR, for the development of Map of risk. On a round table would be presented and discussed the assessed in Activity 1 risk- Environmental, Biological, Health, Technological, Natural, Health and biological risks, their prevention and the mitigation of their consequences, the application for risk assessment and Risks Map with an instruction in usage. As a result would be developed a common guideline for risk prevention and management of natural and man-made disasters, leading to the emerging of these risks. The risk info cards, developed as small, easy to be used and portable risk portfolios for the most emerging risks would be designed both as paper cards and as mobile applications for phones. For the capacity building, increasing of disaster resilience and improving of the knowledge of the administration, managerial business representatives, farmers and citizens to manage prevention of risks and to act in emergencies for environmental protection, sustainable and secure business, different training and public awareness campaigns would be organized. There would be developed also a study on capabilities of workers/farmers/administrative stuff and their knowledge for risk prevention management named “My Risk Knowledge”. The Creation of Virtual Risk HUB, designed for all project’s actors with the mobile Risk Unit for information, monitoring, training, consultations at the area of risk prevention, is one of the project’s major assets because of the role of the HUB as a common platform for business, education, research, government and possibility for the stakeholders to meet collaborate, exchange information, good practices, knowledge. Its specific function will be to consolidate, provide and promote knowledge about the size and added value of the risk prevention for business, administration and citizens as a cross point between people and governance which will allow better and more focused actions for environmental protection and sector investment in the future acting as a centre of risk prevention excellence. The mobile risk unit would be equipped with portable devices for measurement of different risks/hazards /: radiation, poisoning substances determination, protective devices and clothes, gas masks etc./which would be implemented in the planned trainings within the project The final conference for the dissemination of project results and outcomes -“Risk management prevention – the perspective for the sustainable development of the cross border region” such as the two opening conferences at the beginning are part of the project’s public awareness process and information sharing initiatives in the field of efficient risk prevention and management. As a result of the project would be published one common guideline and final conference book. There would be developed 25 reports within the subject of risk assessment and prevention management, different communication and visualization materials, relevant with the program and EU requirements. The project would affect directly 58 representatives of the target groups and indirectly about 880 beneficiaries and stakeholders representatives.

titleEn: Bulgarian – Macedonian Cross Border Cooperation for Capacity building for Competitiveness and Innovation
titleBg: Българо-македонско трансгранично сътрудничество за повишаване на капацитета за конкурентоспособност и иновации
summaryEn:
Main aim of the project is to increase capacities for competitiveness and innovativeness of local businesses and administration in cross border region of North-east Macedonia (6 municipalities) and the District of Kyustendil (9 municipalities). 
The project will be implemented through several stages, starting with an analysis of the current situation in the field of competitiveness and innovation (C&I) of the businesses, as well as analysis of current support (administration, consultants, NGOs and other organizations) to develop the C&I of the companies. Those analyses will define the gaps in C&I and the training needs in this area, and will indicate the best practices of companies/institutions that have a well-developed system for C&I. This is the general base for the development of programs and methodologies for trainings of consultants and representatives from companies and administration, with the focus on capacity development on C&I.
An additional contribution through this project will be the directly support received by 10 companies on which will be carried out a detailed analysis based on the already adopted and approved European methodology. This will contribute trough the identification of the essential elements for improvement of their work and processes in terms of increased productivity, exports, developing new products and services, and new ways of innovative entrepreneurial behavior.
The results of the project will represent a scientific basis for further recommendation and defined activities, by a recognized European methodological approach adapted to the needs of these two cross-border regions in order to influence the strengthening of cross-border cooperation.
The change achieved through this project will affect both regions by the capacity development of the institutions for entrepreneurship and innovation support in order to increase competitiveness and innovative approach of the SMEs in both regions.

titleEn: Building international competitiveness of the textile companies in the cross border region MK-BG

summaryEn:
The main aim the project is to improve the image of the textile industry sector and to increase competitiveness of local producers that will create preconditions for sustainable development of the cross-border region. The project will influence the local communities regarding industry perception and improve industry image by raising awareness towards usage of regional brands and products. The project will try to build strong partnerships and develop high quality supply chains based on trust and common understanding. Additional project benefit is the contribution to the economic development by increasing company competitiveness on international markets add values on their products.
Activities that will be realized throw the implementation of the project are: Creating Vision of the Region; Developing a Regional Positioning Strategy; Developing the region as a brand; Get the local government, business sector and community involved in the industry strengthening; Communicate the region as a brand; and Approaching international target markets.

Working meetings and workshops will be organized in order to define the vision of the textile industry in the region, develop positioning strategy and communication plan that will get local governments, business and community from the region to by in and further participate in the economical strengthening of the region and its competitiveness. By using the service design approach, the project will do proper planning, organizing companies and develops good communication components among supply chain stakeholders that will improve its image, emphasize the quality of the products and the interaction between the production companies and the community.
Through the activities the project will intensify the cross-border cooperation between the business sector, local governmental institutions and communities and will bring them together on a united front to jointly discuss common issues in the textile and apparel industry sector and address challenges that need to be overcome in order to increase competitiveness of the sector in the cross-border region. The developed vision of the region, positioning strategy as well as activities aimed to improve industry image and bring it closer to European companies and gain trust among partners can be easily replicated by other regions. Project activities, developed documents and gained good practices raise awareness of companies about working principles and will further include companies from the sector. The established contact between companies of both countries, part of different supply chains, will enable them to improve their knowledge and exchange experience and know-how in developing their own product (brand) and positioning themselves as a reliable partner. Developed document will present long term activities and provide direction to companies how to act on the market in future in order to strengthen their position.

Organization of workshop with local bussinissmen, bazaars in Shtip and Gotse Delchev, and participation with joint stand at fair in Skopje, will enable them to cooperate, make contacts and enable basis for future development of their home activities into micro or small firm.

It will support the goal of equal participation of women in the labor market. Successful implementation of the planned activities, through basic business and IT trainings, will be the ground, possibility for further developing of these home businesses into micro and small firms, through active involvement on the market. summaryEn:
The project aims to establish sustainable cooperation between Municipality of Gevgelija and Bansko Economic Development Agency, based on the implementation of initiatives in the field of tourism related to better conservation and sustainable use of the rich natural and cultural heritage in the cross-border region. Activities contribute to enhancing economic cooperation, improving knowledge and experience in developing and implementing joint projects and raising public awareness of the benefits of cross-border initiatives. The project stimulates the convergence of all sections of the population and builds networks for business cooperation, exchange of experience and joint activities in the field of tourism, culture and ecology and provides development of year-round tourism in the cross-border region.

The construction of the tourist site "Dinkut" develops the tourism potential through the sustainable use of the natural heritage in the area of Gevgelija municipality on the basis of the implementation of cooperation initiatives in the sphere of tourism related to better preservation and sustainable utilization of the rich natural and cultural heritage in the cross-border region. The actions included interventions which contribute to the enhancement of the economic cooperation in the cross-border region, improvement of the knowledge and expertise for developing and implementing joint projects and raising the public awareness on the benefits of the cross-border initiatives. The project ensure development of all-yearly tourism in the cross-border region stimulates the cohesion of all population groups and build up networks for business cooperation, exchange of experience and joint activities in the field of tourism, culture and ecology.

The "Dinkut" tourist site is planned as a place for sports, recreation and entertainment and includes the following attractions: summer cinema; a place for sports and fitness, a children's playground with modern equipment; an artificial climbing wall; playground for football; playground with equipment from natural materials; climbing paths from natural materials for adults and more. The completed tourist site will offer local people and tourists a wide variety of sports, relaxation and entertainment facilities that will enhance the region's tourist potential and enhance the quality of life and socio-economic status of the local population.

The implementation of the project involves activities such as: study and analysis of the natural and cultural heritage in the cross-border region of Gevgelija - Bansko; creating a basic document for the development of mobile applications; developing a website, a mobile application for tourist information and providing information on Facebook in the field of conservation of the material and immaterial natural, historical and cultural heritage and resources in the cross-border region of Gevgelija - Bansko; the formation of cultural initiatives and new business opportunities.

The project creates conditions for the development of a regional communications network based on an innovative Android and iOS mobile application uploaded to Google Play and the App Store for free download.

titleEn: Support to National Policies for Inclusion of Roma and Marginalized Groups in Education and Labour Market through Promoting Innovative Systems, Integrating Mainstream and Community Development Interventions
summaryEn:
The Project “Integrated Innovative Systems for Roma Education and Labour Inclusion: Support to National Policies for Inclusion of Roma and Marginalized Groups in Education and Labour Market through Promoting Innovative Systems, Integrating Mainstream and Community Development Interventions” is developed by NGOs from Bulgaria, Hungary and Romania in order to address inefficiency and substantial gaps of Roma social inclusion interventions in the Region.
In large-scale the Project will contribute to the implementation of the priorities of the Cooperation Programme for Social cohesion, and for good governance of the Danube Region.
The thematic focus of the Project corresponds to Priority 9 “People & Skills” the Seed Money Facility projects, and in particular to the Topic 2: “Promoting inclusive education and labour markets, including second-chance education, focusing on marginalised communities (e.g. Roma)”.
The Project will identify and tackle the obstacles to inclusive education systems and labour marketsл It will develop innovative systems to increase the inclusiveness of the state policies through integrating the mainstream measures with community development approach aimed at mobilizing the internal community potential. It is focused on improving educational outcomes and labour integration of isolated Roma communities and marginalized groups through integrated holistic measures, addressing both the communities and educational and labour environments, and involving all relevant stakeholders in multi-level partnerships and joint actions.
It will promote national partnerships for joint action between public authorities (national and local) and civil society stakeholders, including target communities, and hereby will help enhancing the transnational cooperation between the key actors in these partnerships from the target countries in the Danube Region.

titleEn: Danube Strategy Point – A Secretariat for the Danube Region
summaryEn:
3. A new Secretariat for EUSDR The success story of EUSDR should be continued and a new DSP, a secretariat for the EUSDR, should be established. It mainly has to help organizing the tasks and duties of actors on the field of EUSDR. The main tasks have been defined and grouped by the NCs: Internal and external communication, Support for EUSDR stakeholders (Presidency, NCs, PACs), Coordination between EUSDR stakeholders and financing/funding instruments,Capacity building towards PACs and non-EU countries wherever needed, Monitoring and evaluation of the Strategy.
The first four tasks are closely interlinked with each other. The role of the secretariat will be to support stakeholders wherever needed, in cooperation with funding instruments, in communication to the public (one or the other important brochures or leaflets should be translated to DR-languages) and in building capacities for specific needs of one or the other PAC and/or for capacity building for EUSDR in non-EU countries. The secretariat will also have to encourage collaboration between stakeholders of EUSDR, because the secretariat is e.g. collecting information about activities of PACs and capable of possible synergies. One of the most visible actions of EUSDR is the Annual Forum. The secretariat should support the Presidency in content issues, technical and organizational subjects as desired by the Presidency. The fifth task includes the monitoring of the current activities of PACs. As DTP-JS has established an elaborated reporting system, the DSP new will rely on DTP-JS’s reporting system for PACs (Annex 1 – PACs progress report) and in cooperation with the PACs – add a qualitative description of activities. An Annual Report drafted by DSP will be.
available again. Following the roadmap of the Presidency, in close cooperation with EUSDR-stakeholders, the secretariat will promote procurement, the contracting and the evaluation process itself. According to the results of the evaluation, a proposal for adapting the Action Plan and its structure will be drafted in cooperation with NCs, PACs and DG Regio. 
Mission Statement EUSDR has proved a successful way of improving the integration and coherent development of the Danube Region. The role of EUSDR is to promote regional and social cohesion with respect to the cultural diversity of the Danube Region. The secretariat of EUSDR is the supportive body for all stakeholders within the Strategy, will encourage cooperation between stakeholders and other actors (funding facilities, administration, civil society, local/regional/national authorities), make the Strategy visible for as many people as possible and documentations about the added value of the Strategy for countries and people. The secretariat will – in close cooperation with NCs, PACs and DG Regio - stimulate the process of evaluation of EUSDR and – according to the results of the evaluation – will make proposals for adapting the Strategy’s Action Plan and its structure to make EUSDR fit for the forthcoming MFF. Austria and Romania Both countries were supporting the idea of a macro regional strategy for the Danube Region from the very beginning and introduced this idea to the European Council successfully. Austria and Romania want to promote the next steps towards a prosperous Danube Region and help to make EUSDR more visible, soundly organised and fit for the forthcoming MFF-period. Both countries are experienced in coordinating Priority Areas. On the Austrian side the City of Vienna is ready to step in as Lead Partner for the secretariat of EUSDR. The Romanian Ministry for Regional Development has great experience in managing ESIF programmes and structures, including a secretariat, and will step in as Project Partner. This cooperation is an example of cooperation of different levels of government and administration. Connectivity of both, Vienna and the Romanian Capital Bucharest with the Danube Region is excellent.

titleEn: Better connection of Alexandria and Cherven Bryag to TEN-T
summaryEn:
The project addresses important common challenges related to not well developed transport infrastructure in the RO-BG cross-border area.
The accessibility to TEN-T infrastructures for the main urban centers is far better than for the small/mediumsized cities, especially along the Danube. It is then a priority to bridge the accessibility gap between peripheral rural and urban regions and regional economic centers.

Both Alexandria and Cherven Bryag are tertiary nodes but not well connected to TEN-T transport network, situation that leads to poor competitiveness, mobility and traffic issues. The quality of infrastructure networks is a major factor to attract  firms and their investments. The most important barrier to road infrastructure development for the two municipalities is the financial barrier.

The overall objective of the project is to ensure better connectivity at the TEN-T for Alexandria and Cherven-Bryag in a safety traffic conditions. The development of transport networks in the cross-border region will facilitate interregional cooperation and will help to increase competitiveness of the business sector, labor mobility and, however, to sustainable regional development. Rehabilitation of road infrastructure, respectively 4500,20 m in Alexandria and 8000 m in Cherven-Bryag will improve safety traffic conditions, competitiveness of both municipalities, will allow better exploitation of tourism potential and will improve the cooperation capacity of the partners in transport and safety traffic issues. A rehabilitated road infrastructure will allow for improved travel time and predictability for a journey, help reduce pollution, help to limiting traffic jams.
The project aims to contribute to the consolidation of a sustainable European and cross-border transport system connected to the main TEN-T network. All the activities that will be carried out in the project contribute to the achievement of the Programme output and result indicators targeted by this call, as follows: I1 – Total length of reconstructed and upgraded roads is 12,5 km, which represent 31,20% from the Programme indicator to be achieved by the present call; I2 – Number of joint mechanisms (a best practice guide for the road intervention/construction to limit the duration, discomfort, risk and pollution, black-spot maps for areas of  both municipalities, awareness raising campaign, a driver guide) to facilitate the connection of tertiary nodes to TEN-T infrastructure: 5,  which is 22,73% from the Programme indicator to be achieved by the present call; I5 -  Financial indicator: 7960000 euro, which is  15,8 % from the indicator to be achieved by the present call for the Priority Axis 1; I6 -  Cross border population served by modernized infrastructure leading to TEN-T: 74.648 inhabitants, which is 11,97 % from the Program target.
The project emphasizes the cross-border area need for an enhanced and transport network. The current infrastructure grid reflects the concept of the frontier as “dead-end” leading not only to low connectivity between the two countries but also to low accessibility of cross-border areas to own existing national infrastructure major corridors. Regional mobility is a condition for a balanced regional development and for an equal access to education, employment and public services.

In order to capitalize the advantages of the geographic location, the two municipalities need adequate road infrastructure connected to the main European and cross-border transport nodes. Although Alexandria is not situated at the border with Bulgaria, but in cross-border area, the roads proposed for rehabilitation are not only of local importance, because the city is located at the TEN-T network (core Dr. Tr. Severin–Craiova–Bucharest) and respectively the rehabilitation of the roads will improve connection to the tertiary node Rosiorii de Vede and to the crossing points Zimnicea–Svishtov and Turnu Magurele–Nikopol. Also, Cherven Bryag is an tertiary node to TEN-T and the rehabilitated roads aren’t only of local importance, but connecting the municipality (with localities Telish and Devenci) to the core TEN-T infrastructure Cherven Bryag – Pleven.
The project will contribute to the following results: reduction of the gap between peripheral, badly accessible regions and well-connected urban centers, improvement of the connectivity between Romania and Bulgaria: effective connection of tertiary nodes to the core network TEN-T to reduce transportation time and optimizing logistics by improved traffic management including black spot maps, incidents/emergencies detection and management, improvement of safety, security and environmental performance.

The modernization of infrastructures does not means only to rehabilitate roads but also to enhance the overall transport planning and management of the area. Road reconstructions or upgrading go along with an improved technology in order to alert traffic participants by electronic warning panels, to share information throughout the cross-border area, in other words to make transportations facilities easier and safer for the user. So, it will be done a best practice guideline on roads interventions about specific requirements for tender book (specific conditions) towards the road constructor to ensure safety, fluidity of the traffic during construction works and optimize the duration of the works. It will be done Blackspot Maps for both partners that will show where road casualties are highly concentrated. For disabilities persons will be special facilities, like acoustic and movable traffic lights, guide bands for blinds etc.

The project will be a solid experience for the administrative cooperation on common challenges and for future collaborations. By implementing the project, will be carried out awareness raising campaign in order to: promote better connectivity in cross border region, foster eco-driving skills, promote sustainable mobility habits, promote the advantages of using the rehabilitates roads. A driver guide will provide information regarding safe driving tips, road rules in both countries, driver education, and the risks of alcohol, drugs and speeding. In Alexandria, the Traffic monitoring center will manage the new electronic warning panels from the rehabilitated roads. The materials used in the construction works will be modern and environmentally friendly. The results of project implementation are sustainable and might be considered a proper initial framework for the implementation of other border area development joint programs, in terms of economic trade, labor mobility, urban-rural disparities elimination, educational and cultural exchanges etc.

The total budget of the project is 7.960.000 euro.

titleEn: EN-able IN-clusion for disabled persons by improved mobility and safety in the Danube area
summaryEn: The EN-IN project corresponds to the PA1b of the EUSDR and focus on development of socio-environmentally appropriate and socio-economically sustainable transport services in rural areas for improved mobility of people.It aims to promote the active inclusion and full participation of disabled and elderly people in the Danube area societies through improvement of conditions for their mobility. It is widely known that Danube area transport services are lagging other EU regions and this is even more evident for the provision of transport services, accessibility and mobility for disabled and elderly persons living in the Danube region. Often neglected in the mobility and transport schemes, the improvement of mobility of disabled and other marginalised groups of people in the Danube area is significant barrier to sustainable and inclusive economic growth and development. The EN-IN project aims to tackle this important issue by preparation of multifaceted strategic transnational project that will aim at increased intensity of cooperation between important stakeholders, facilitate transnational exchange of best practices and drafting of strategy for improvement of the mobility and safety for disabled and elderly people in the Danube region. The EN-IN is fully in line with the EUSDR PA1b declaration that the right to mobility and accessibility to health services (hospitals), education (schools, universities), culture (museums, opera/drama) should be equal for all people of the Danube region, in remote and rural areas as well. The project will assess the needs and challenges in relation to accessibility of the disabled people and propose sustainable solution   for the development of services in that respect by including creation of the online platform  for provision of information and availability of services to disabled persons in the overall project proposal.It also tackles PA3 and topic 2: development of applications and innovative tools for tourists.

titleEn: Joint risk management and partnership in the border region Calarasi - Dobrich
summaryEn:
Common challenge: A border can be a barrier but it can also be a gateway, an opportunity and a resource. Cross-border cooperation brings together the communities on both sides of the border. It helps to transform the border into a good opportunity for development. Analyzing the current situation in the border region Calarasi-Dobrich, it was noticed that both regions are facing similar problems. During last years the cross-border region has been highly exposed to climate change and natural disasters such as droughts and floods, coastal erosion and riverbanks, landslides, earthquakes, fires, etc. As mentioned within  EC rules several times, it recommends strengthening joint management of common risks across borders. A series of flood events during 2010, 2012, 2014, 2015 and 2017 determined the necessity to adopt common procedures to improve the management efficiency of hydro geological and hydraulic emergencies by means of a better territorial organization of responsible authorities. Also, in the cross border region, an increased number of calls reporting the occurrence of emergency situations have evolved constantly thus making necessary the improvement of managing capacity of authorities.


Overall objective: Calarasi ESI and Dobrichka Municipality Administration  willing to solve the common challenge, jointly decided to participate in this project. JORIMA aims to improve and to ensure an efficient management for joint interventions in emergency situations in the border Calarasi-Dobrich, to increase co-ordination and efficiency in response of authorities in joint early warning, in line with the EU policies and guidelines. During its 2-years duration, the project endeavors to increase the cross-border cooperation in emergency management by means of several actions: To purchase modern equipment for early warning and quick reaction to the emergency situation – a electronic wallscreen will be delivered in the Calarasi ESI headquarters and delivery of equipment for quick reaction to prevent the negative effect of disasters (like floods, fire, storms etc) in Dobrichka Muicipality . The new solutions for minimizing the time for reaction in emergency will ensure the localization of the risk event, the easy contact of local decision maker which ensures administrative functions. Additional to this a common Strategy and Action Plan will be elaborated for responding to various possible types of risk situations of natural and anthropic characteristic of Calarasi County and Dobrich District. A network of partnerships among territorial entities involved in civil protection activities will be created. 


Project contribution: As a result of the project it is expected to have a Common Strategy and a Joint Action Plan; modern intervention equipments purchased, partnership created for risk prevention and mitigate the negative effect  from the disaster.

Also, the project contributes to the programme output indicators, increasing the population benefiting from actions of risk management through enhancing the quick response of authorities in case of emergency situations. Through this project the purchased equipment will be facilitated a rapid and efficient intervention of the authorities responsible for saving the people and their property. The Strategy and Action Plan for common activities against the flood and other natural disaster will be drafted. The cross border co-operation common issues will be analyzed and common solutions will be identified.


Project approach: The strategy and action plan will be developed with after consultations with the representatives of target groups and representatives of public authorities, with responsibilities in the field: police, gendarmerie, border police, County ambulance service, NGOs, companies. Through workshops and disaster simulation exercises conducted under the project, the population will be informed and educated on the reaction in case of emergencies. In the end, the final beneficiary of this investments will be the cross-border population. Population benefiting from actions of risk management is around 510 000 habitants.

In the framework of the project a joint partnership will be created for early warning and emergency response. The project was Joint developped - designed in common by partners from both sides of the border. The activities in the project will be carried out and coordinated among partners on both sides of the border. The project will be in joint implementation. The Project will be managed by Joint project team For implementing the project activities, reimbursable financial assistance will be used which will accelerate the project implementation in a much shorter time frame than if it was made from partners' own financial resources.

Through the purchased equipments the population in Dobrichka Municipality and Calarasi Counti will benefit from the rapid and effective of the authorities. Population benefiting from flood protection measures is around 307 131 people.

Increasing the capacity of the responsible authorities to intervene by purchasing modern equipments. Thus, in case of fire it will mitigate the negative effects and will protect people and assets. Population benefiting from forest fire protection measures 307 131 people.

The 510 000 residents of Calarasi County, Romania and Dobrichka Municipality, Bulgaria will benefit directly of the efficient management of emergency situations, as specified within Specific Objective 3.1 of the Programme, as provided for in Specific Objective 3 that are or could be affected by the consequences and damage caused by disasters included in this project will benefit from the following projects results: Disaster simulation exercises and educating people for disasters. Prompt feedback of the authorities by upgrading and equipping with modern logistics the Calarasi ESI headquarters; and by providing equipment for rapid intervention.

The new approach and expected result from the project is the creation of the Joint network of Partners for joint early warning and emergency response and the exchange of experience by the simulation exercises in the two site of the border as a result of the Joint Strategy and the Joint Action plan, as well as the education of the population how to  react in case of emergencies. The expected number of partnerships is about 11.

titleEn: Improving the connection of tertiary nodes Mangalia and Balchik to TEN-T infrastructure
summaryEn:
This project comes to greet an issue widely spread in the border area, namely the poor connectivity of the inhabitants to TEN-T network, even if their city is situated on or near the TEN-T (core or comprehensive). As described by the European Commission, the purpose of the TEN-T is to promote transport chains for passenger and freight, while the roads comprising the actual TEN-T network are mainly highways or European roads. At the same time, the result indicator of the Programme refers to the population of the cross-border area served by modernized infrastructure leading to TEN-T. Therefore, the connectivity to TEN-T is, in fact, defined by how the inhabitants can access, from their cities, the highways and European roads, components of the TEN-T. As a result, the existing road infrastructure is the one that establishes if the inhabitants have an adequate connectivity to TEN-T, and not necessarily the geographical location of the cities in relation to the indicative TEN-T map. This applies for Mangalia and Balchik, 2 cities on the Black Sea coast, where the connectivity to the passing-by TEN-T is impaired by the poor road infrastructure that serves the inhabitants. And not only the inhabitants are affected, but also the touristic attractiveness of the cities (given that Mangalia and Balchik have great touristic potential) and the economic development, highly dependent on the connection between waterways and road infrastructure, both cities being multimodal nodes. In conclusion, the common challenge represented by the weak road infrastructure has a negative impact on both partners on 2 major directions: the access of its inhabitants to TEN-T and towards the border point Vama Veche – Durankulak and the accomplishment of the full economic potential of the area, taking into account the strong touristic potential and the fact that both municipalities are multimodal nodes with strong naval activity. At the same time, the cities do not benefit from appropriate route guidance related to the large number of tourists that visit Mangalia and Balchik. Another challenge is that the public transport is not correlated in a cross-border manner and only has a local perspective. The overall objective of the project will be to improve access for the inhabitants of the 2 partners and for all those who are transiting the cities to TEN-T and to create the premises of further economic development of the region, by proper connection of the multimodal points.

The change that the project will make is to improve cross-border traffic conditions (private and public) in the area, by joint focus on a cross-border perspective. In Mangalia, the modernization of the roads will help drain the traffic in and out of town, with a focus on passenger cars and tourist attractions. A total of 17 roads will be modernized, many of them with a direct connection to TEN-T, represented by E87, including the main artery of the city. By applying the 2 km radius, it is estimated that 90% of the inhabitants will benefit from the improved infrastructure, resulting thus in a major impact on the life of the city. It will lead to less traffic jams, less pollution, improved safety for all traffic participants and better access to touristic objectives. In Balchik, the project will create a better connection for the city towards the E87, part of TEN-T, in 2 ways: through the main road of the city, Cherno More, which leads most of the inner-city traffic directly to E87, and through 2 other roads acting as beltway, directly connected to E87 towards the Romanian border. These last 2 roads are also connecting the tourist attractions from the Black Sea, allowing the tourists to avoid the city in order to arrive on the coast. It will lead to less traffic jams, less crowded inner-city traffic, less pollution and the premises for the economic development of the businesses in the area (e.g. tourist resorts). The project contributes to the output indicators I1 - Total length of reconstructed or upgraded roads with more than 20 km of modernized roads (7.8 km in Mangalia and 9 km in Balchik) and I2 - Number of joint mechanisms to facilitate the connection of secondary/tertiary nodes to TEN-T infrastructure with 4 joint mechanisms (route guidance, feasibility study addressing cross-border transport, traffic safety measures and awareness raising activities). As mentioned before, the road infrastructure improved by the project represents direct connection of the cities to the TEN-T network. The approach adopted by the project is highly orientated on the cross-border perspective. This is due to the fact that Balchik & Mangalia share common characteristics regarding the economic and social development.
